jobs.title: Program Leader II (ADULTS) - Team M
jobs.description:
Description:

**Job Title:** Program Leader II (ADULTS)

**Employer:** Pomeroy Recreation and Rehabilitation Center

**Reports To:** Program Supervisor

**Department:** Adult Day

**Employment Status:** Full-time

**Starting Rate:** $24.50/hour

**Position Summary:** Under the supervision of the Program Supervisor, the Program Leader II provides services and supports for individuals with disabilities. A Program Leader II is responsible for a variety of activities such as planning and leading opportunities for growth and development, working directly with individuals to encourage participation in activities, providing instruction, and carrying out supports related to the physical well-being and comfort of persons served. The Program Leader II may also assist in the orienting and training of new staff, interns, and volunteers as assigned.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Service Delivery:**

* Provide instruction, support, and supervision to one or more persons served in a variety of activities and environments.
* Understand and consistently apply appropriate teaching strategies when working with persons served.
* Responsible for the safety of individuals served including observing and meeting safety requirements in both facility and community-based activities.
* Assist individuals with eating, toileting, personal hygiene, dressing, and other daily living skills as needed.
* Provide physical assistance to persons served including transferring, pushing wheelchairs, loading, and unloading from vehicles, and physical guidance as needed.
* Support and facilitate participant involvement in swimming and aquatic activities as needed, based on program schedules and participant interest. Swimming instruction or participation may be required as part of program responsibilities, with appropriate flexibility for medical restrictions, safety considerations, and other individual circumstances.
* Provide all other aspects of service delivery as needed.

**Program Coordination:**

* Responsible for the development and implementation of Individual Service Plans, goals and objectives, based on the needs/interests of persons served.
* Responsible for the planning, facilitating, executing, and evaluating social, vocational, recreational, self-help/advocacy, developmental activities, and skills training through in-center groups, work activities, and community-based outings in accordance with the individual’s service plan.
* Demonstrate ability to adapt teaching techniques, materials, and equipment to meet individual/group abilities, needs, and interests.
* Ensure program supplies are available for activities, including setting up and breaking down rooms/materials.
* Identify and collaboratively work with other team members in use of community and center resources to enhance individual growth and development opportunities. Suggest ideas to develop new activities and service planning skills.
* Assist with daily/weekly/monthly programming and activities as required.
* Provide other aspects of program coordination as needed.

**Administrative/Professional:**

* Maintain individual records and submit accurate reports per procedures established by the department. Includes initiating communication (oral and written) on successes, specific problems, or concerns of persons served.
* Work effectively as part of a team to accomplish the mission of PRRC. This includes developing and maintaining positive relations with persons served, care providers, employers, staff, affiliated organizations, and the community in general.
* Attend staff meetings and professional growth classes including in-services, conferences, and workshops.
* Assist supervisors with training new staff, interns, or volunteers as needed
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Possess ability to perform and teach basic mathematical skills, operations using units of American money, and weight, volume and distance measurements. Demonstrate the ability to problem solve practical problems and deal with an array of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Bachelor’s degree in rehabilitation counseling, vocational rehabilitation, or related field preferred. Knowledge of Americans with Disabilities Act and other laws – preferred. Bilingual preferred.

Requirements:

* One year related experience and/or training working with individuals with disabilities
* Working effectively with a variety of personalities and to be sensitive to the needs/communication of persons with differing abilities
* Ability to work independently on assigned tasks as well as to accept direction on given assignments
* Ability to perform multiple tasks and projects with varying time sensitive deadlines.
* Proficient and competent in the latest versions of Microsoft Office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Publisher, etc.) FileMaker, Windows and Macintosh programs/operating systems, email, and Internet.
* Criminal Record Clearance

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Diversity - Demonstrates knowledge of EEO policy; Shows respect and sensitivity for cultural differences; educates others on the value of diversity; Promotes a harassment- free environment; Builds a diverse workforce.
* Ethics - Treats people with respect; Keeps commitments; Inspires the trust of others; Works with integrity and ethically; Upholds organizational values.
* Customer Service - Manages difficult or emotional customer situations; Responds promptly to customer needs; Solicits customer feedback to improve service; Responds to requests for service and assistance; Meets commitments.
* Planning/Organizing - Prioritizes and plans work activities; U

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Family Justice Center (the “Center”) is a warm and welcoming one-stop center for victims of interpersonal violence (IPV) -- domestic violence, sexual assault, child abuse, elder abuse and human trafficking. The Center serves victims and survivors regardless of their income, immigration status or location. The Center is a public-private partnership committed to creating a vibrant community free of coercion and fear. It supports the West Center located in Richmond, the Central Center in Concord, the East Center in Antioch, the South Center in Danville, and the Solano Center in Fairfield.

**POSITION SUMMARY**:

We are accepting applications for one full-time Program Coordinator. We provide generous fringe benefits, including paid holidays, paid annual and sick leave, health insurance coverage, dental and vision coverages, life insurance and retirement

benefits.

Program Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and supporting the organization's long term safety programs for youth and adults.

· Coordinate special projects (festivals, community listening sessions, workshops, informational meetings).

· Data input, reporting and documentation.

· Facilitation, planning and preparation of monthly community group gatherings, program cohorts, volunteers/interns, multidisciplinary team meetings that include clinicians, psychiatrists, navigators and partners.

· Supporting Site Director with end-to-end program and event coordination.

· Intake, scheduling, and follow up of program clients needed.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**:

· Review program goals and activities to meet program goals.

· Implement program initiatives & activities, oversee grant deliverables, and refine program designs.

· Coordination with partners, making referrals, following up regarding status of referred clients.

· Engage with partners through outreach.

· Document and report on program outcomes using organization databases like JotForm and Empowerdb.

· Perform other duties, function, special projects, and responsibilities as assigned and deemed necessary by the Site and Executive Director.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**:

· Demonstrated Knowledge of or a background in domestic violence, sexual assault, child abuse, stalking, elder abuse, or human trafficking.

· Excellent oral and written communication skills, including public speaking, attention to detail and proofreading.

· Strong analytical and organizational skills and problem-solving capabilities

· Proven project/program coordinator/management experience and report writing skills.

· Microsoft Word, Excel, Canva, Dropbox, and Google proficiency.

· High comfort with data collection and evaluation through Excel and Google Sheets.

· Ability and willingness to learn in new areas and practices.

· Teamwork and interpersonal flexibility.

· Able to work independently.

· Self-starter and takes initiative.

· Interest in learning and practicing leadership

· Cultural responsiveness and an alignment with our values and commitments to equity and inclusion.

· Fluency in Spanish or Asian languages is preferred.

· Ability to travel.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

· Bachelor’s Degree in a related field or equivalent work experience.

· Minimum of two years’ worth of experience relevant to the position: training, curriculum, development, program design, and implementation, coaching and victim advocacy.

**SPECIAL CONSIDERATION:**

· Ability to create effective social media posts.

· Excellence in website design and graphics.

· Superb writing skills.

· Ability to fix computers and troubleshoot technical issues.

· Interest in or experience with non-violence work.

· Innovative and creative self-starter.

· Interest in staff and organization development work.

· Deep understanding of public systems.

**We practice equity in all aspects of the organization and value diversity of culture, thought, and lived experiences. We seek talented, qualified individuals who will contribute to the culture of diversity and inclusion at the Family Justice Center.**

Pay: $29.00 - $33.00 per hour

Expected hours: 37.5 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Program Coordinator I
jobs.description:
At **Benchmark** , we are driven by our purpose: to innovate for a healthier, safer, and better-connected world to create a brighter future. When you join us, you become part of a team passionate about making a meaningful impact across various sectors, including commercial aerospace, defense, advanced computing, next-generation communications, complex industrials, medical, and semiconductor capital equipment. We prioritize career growth, fostering a culture that ensures you reach your full potential. At Benchmark, your work is purpose-driven, enabling you to create a positive impact on the world and make your career truly meaningful. You’ll be part of a collaborative and inclusive team that values your ideas and contributions.

**Summary** :
  
Support the Program Managers for Engineering Change Orders, Sales Order management and Accounts Receivable. Support the Master Scheduler by providing daily reports using Baan. Ensure sales order accuracy to drive accurate MRP. Follow all procedures with consistent adherence to company policies and guidelines.

**Responsibilities** :
  

* Analyze customer purchase orders for compliance to customer’s contract terms and conditions
* Verify pricing and process customer POs and Sales Orders in accurate and timely manner
* Proactively identify potential discrepancies prior to data entry and engage Program Managers in resolving discrepancies
* Maintain documentation and database to support pricing quoted to customers
* Assist Program Managers with program accounts receivable past-due balances, providing data necessary for resolution
* Provide daily reports to Master Scheduler using Baan to support production scheduling
* Maintain a positive, professional relationship with Benchmark team members
* All employees are responsible for the Quality of their work to ensure BEI meets, or exceeds Customer Satisfaction.

**Other information** :
  

* Begin to understand the total business operation to include material procurement, order entry, forecasting, manufacturing, invoicing, customer returns, inventory levels and on-time delivery
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Effective interpersonal skills
* Effective multitasking skills and the ability to take on additional responsibilities as required
* Effective organization and prioritization skills
* Demonstrate attention to detail
* Demonstrate discretion, confidentiality and professionalism when representing the company
* Ability to work overtime as needed
* Ability to work with diverse groups
* Participate in a continuous improvement activity
* High School Diploma or GED
* 0-2+ years of experience with Microsoft Office supporting mid-senior management levels

**Education:**

**Geographical Location:** California:Concord

**Physical Location:** Concord, CA - 4041

**Shift: Shift 1**

**Work Schedule:** M-F 0800-1700

**Full Time**

In our innovative environment, you'll work with cutting-edge technology, leading the way in engineering design and delivering world-class manufacturing services for products that make a real difference in the lives of others. At **Benchmark,** your career is more than just a job. It’s an opportunity to be part of something bigger, where your work matters and helps shape a brighter future for everyone. **Together, we will achieve extraordinary things.**

**Safety-Sensitive Position and Drug Testing Notice:** This position is classified as safety-sensitive because impairment while performing job duties could pose a significant risk of harm. Where permitted by applicable law or required by federal regulation, Benchmark will conduct a pre-employment drug screen. Benchmark maintains a drug- and alcohol-free workplace and may conduct reasonable-suspicion and post-incident testing in accordance with applicable law.

**Compensation Range:** $23.51 to $29.38 USD. Many factors are considered in compensation decisions, including but not limited to skills, certifications, licensures, experience, training, incumbent data, and other business needs.

**Benefits and Other Compensation:**Benchmark provides a comprehensive benefits package, including a Bonus Plan, 401(k), Paid Time Off, and Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance, all based on scheduled hours. Benchmark complies with applicable state and local employee leave laws.

**Application Deadline:** This job posting will remain open until filled.

**Additional Notices:** Benchmark adheres to applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits. This includes, but is not limited to, providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. Candidates applying for remote work based in Washington state, may obtain PTO eligibility for this position by emailing careers@bench.com .

**Export Control:** This position may involve access to information, technology, or materials that are regulated under U.S. export control laws. Employment in this role may be contingent upon verification that you qualify as a U.S. Person under federal regulations. U.S. Persons include U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), and individuals granted asylum or refugee status in the United States. If a candidate does not qualify as a U.S. Person, Benchmark will evaluate the position requirements and applicable legal restrictions to determine whether employment can proceed. In some cases, Benchmark may be unable to move forward with an application due to export control requirements.

Benchmark is an equal opportunity employer. We are bringing together a dynamic workforce with unique talents, life experiences, cultures, and perspectives to promote an innovative, collaborative, and creative place to work. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please email us at careers@bench.com .

jobs.company: Marin City Health and Wellness Center
jobs.title: Call Center Representative
jobs.description:
Summary

  

The Call Center Representative is responsible for ensuring that all calls are answered in a timely fashion, with a pleasant attitude, providing high-level customer services to all patients and callers. Schedules medical patient visits, and answers call for dental and behavioral health. Obtains necessary data and insurance authorizations as appropriate.

  

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Customer Care:

* Answers and directs calls with a pleasant voice in a timely manner
* Schedules patients in accordance with established provider schedules and clinic protocols
* Records no-shows and cancellations in system and patient records while routing patient messages to appropriate clinical staff
* Screens and provides information to patients on Sliding Fee Scale as appropriate
* Accurately captures patient demographics, insurance and structured data into the EHR system with each patient encounter
* Advises patients of clinic policies regarding scheduling, payments, no-shows, etc. and answers questions as appropriate, advises patients to bring in necessary financial and/or insurance documentation as indicated
* Monitors call volume alerts supervisor of changes
* Maintains strict patient confidentiality per HIPPA and company standards
* Ensure superior customer service to patients, including problem resolution
* Performs a variety of miscellaneous clerical tasks as time permits
* Performs other duties as directed, developed or assigned

  

Insurances:

* Verify insurance eligibility at the time of scheduling, with emphasis on Medi-Cal, Medicare, and HMO plans.
* Identify and communicate any eligibility issues to frontline staff before patient visits, ensuring accurate payment or insurance updates are made in advance.
* Document detailed eligibility notes in the appointment billing screen for clear communication with the billing department

Supervisory Responsibility: N/A

  

Qualification Requirements:

  

* High school diploma or equivalency
* Knowledge of standard office policies and procedures
* Experience working on computers; typing/keyboarding speed of at least 40 WPM
* Must have a positive attitude, be a team player, and be able to take directions from supervisor
* Understands and promote the mission, vision, and values of the health center both in the workplace and in the community
* Sensitivity to the needs and situation of multi-cultural population from a variety of income levels
* Ability to manage multiple tasks
* Excellent customer service skills and ability to effectively and respectfully handle dissatisfied patients
* Experience in a medical office setting/FQHC setting
* Responsible for extensive knowledge of programs/insurance & access/eligibility guidelines & applications (including Medi-Cal, CHDP, CPSP, Presumptive Eligibility, Family Pact, Sliding Scale)
* Must possess excellent organization, writing, and verbal skills
* English proficiency required; Spanish proficiency preferred
* Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form

  

Equipment/Machinery: Fax machine, copier, personal computer, telephone, calculator, Microsoft Word/Excel, EHR system, and other software as required.

  

Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an individual to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  

* Stand and walk or sit alternatively depending on specific needs of day. Estimate 20% of time is spent on feet and 80% sitting at desk.
* Have occasional need to perform the following physical activities: bend/stoop/squat, climb stairs, push or pull, reach above shoulders.
* Have occasional need to perform standing and walking activities.
* Constant need to perform the following physical activities: writing/typing, grasping/turning, finger dexterity.
* Lifting/carrying over 10 pounds occasionally. Lifting/carrying less than 10 pounds frequently.

  

Vision requirements: constant need to complete forms, read reports, view computer screen. Frequent need to see small detail. Frequent need to see things clearly beyond arm's reach.

  

Hearing requirements: constant need to communicate over telephone and in person.

  

Travel Requirements: Occasional need to utilize personal transportation to attend meetings or training.

  

Work Environment: The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

jobs.title: PG&E Pole Clearing - Vegetation Program Lead (VPL) Bay Region
jobs.description:
Mountain Engineering is seeking experienced candidates to support PG&E's Pole Clearing Vegetation Program. This Vegetation Program Lead (VPL) position effectively manages and leads vegetation management operations, ensuring compliance with PG&E's standards and safety regulations. The VPL will leverage their extensive experience in hazard tree removal, emergency response, and familiarity with PG&E's vegetation management practices to oversee contractor work, solve complex problems, and lead project teams.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Leads vegetation management operations and outside contractor work performance.

* Works independently to solve moderate to highly complex problems and takes new perspectives on existing solutions, plans, and goals.

* Leads project teams to complete required tasks.

* Performs lead duties for emergency response in accordance with all safety requirements, laws, and regulations, and applicable labor agreements.

* Supports operations and work on process improvement initiatives, schedule, and coordination of VM activities.

* Assists with difficult customers at the direction of the Program. Manager (customer complaints, refusals, difficult access, agencies).

* At the direction of the PG&E Representative clarify expectations and program direction for contractor employees.

* Assists with monitoring the progress and status of pre-inspection and tree work completion.

* Assists with agency meetings and field visits to review VM work as directed by the PG&E Program Manager.

* Assists with management of projects – routine and non-routine.

* Assists in management of the contract review process.

* Perform database “sleuthing” to identify issues.

* Perform other Work as directed by the PG&E Representative.

  

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Associate degree in job-related discipline or equivalent experience.

* Two years of job-related experience with at least one year of experience in a leadership role, as a team leader or project leader.

* Two (2) years of experience in emergency response and/or

* Two (2) years of experience in hazard tree removal projects along utility rights of way.

* The VPL shall be familiar with PG&E’s vegetation management contractors’ work practices, proper arboricultural techniques and practices and other requirements related to line clearances and fire prevention.

  

The above statements and job description are intended to describe the nature and level of work being performed within this job. They are not intended to be a complete list of all responsibilities, duties, and tasks. Other similar or additional duties are performed as assigned.

  

**Physical Demands**

Sitting for long periods of time working at the computer or driving to job sites. Job site visits require walking on uneven ground, climbing, bending, stooping, and crawling in confined or enclosed spaces. Some lifting of materials and equipment up to 50 lbs. Close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. May work long hours during peak seasons.

**Work Environment**

Typical office environment with adequate temperatures and lighting, low levels of noise. Exposed to the conditions of job sites which can include loud noise, dust, fumes, and extreme weather conditions prevalent at the time. May work various shifts or hours, including early mornings, dusk or evenings.

**Benefits**

* Premium Health Coverage for Employee and Dependents (Medical, Dental & Vision)

* Life Insurance

* Long Term Disability

* 40 Hours Paid Vacation

* 7 Paid Holidays

* 5 Paid Sick Days

* 401k – 4% Match

  

**Pre-Employment Controlled Substances Testing of Applicants**.

All applicants to whom the Company has given a conditional offer of employment are required to submit to a pre-employment Controlled Substances test and must receive a negative result as a condition of employment.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Mountain Engineering is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Individuals seeking employment at our company are considered without regards to age, ancestry, color, race, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, religion, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

  

**Notice to Staffing Agencies**

Mountain Engineering will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. Any unsolicited resumes sent to Mountain Engineering, including unsolicited resumes sent to a Mountain Engineering mailing address, fax machine or email address, directly to Mountain Engineering employees, or to Mountain Engineering’s resume database will be considered Mountain Engineering property.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Office Manager
jobs.description:
**About AiDASH**  
  
AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection & Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com.

The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024.

Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!

**The Role**

As our Executive Assistant & Office Manager, you'll run our Palo Alto office and make it a welcoming, well-organized space where our team can do their best work. You'll oversee office operations, coordinate executive schedules and travel, and manage the administrative details that keep a growing global company running smoothly.

You'll work closely with our leadership team and partners across People & Culture, Finance, and Recruiting. This role calls for someone who is proactive, resourceful, and comfortable navigating ambiguity; someone who anticipates needs, takes ownership, and builds structure and processes as the company evolves.

If you enjoy wearing multiple hats, solving problems independently, and creating great experiences for both employees and visitors, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact as we grow.

**How you'll make an impact:**

* **Office & Workplace Operations**
  + Own the day-to-day operations of our Palo Alto office, serving as the primary point of contact for vendors, facilities, and building management
  + Manage the daily lunch program, including vendor relationships, ordering, headcount, dietary requirements, and budget
  + Oversee office supplies, snacks, kitchen operations, and the upkeep of shared spaces
  + Manage incoming and outgoing mail, packages, and deliveries
  + Coordinate office access and badges, meeting room setups, and AV requirements
  + Welcome and assist visitors, customers, partners, and candidates
* **Executive & Business Support**
  + Coordinate calendars, meetings, and travel arrangements for members of the leadership team
  + Arrange catering and logistics for leadership meetings, interview loops, and customer or partner visits
  + Lead the planning and execution of company offsites and leadership retreats, including venue selection, hotel accommodations, agendas, and on-site logistics
* **Employee Experience, Recruiting Coordination & Culture**
  + Plan and coordinate employee engagement activities and celebrations, including birthdays, work anniversaries, company milestones, and holiday events
  + Coordinate workspace and equipment setup for new hires, ensuring a smooth and welcoming first-day experience
  + Partner with Recruiting to coordinate interview schedules and deliver a seamless candidate experience
* **Administrative & Financial Operations**
  + Process invoices, expense reports, and purchase requests in partnership with Finance
  + Coordinate agreements and documents for signature through Adobe Sign and maintain accurate, organized records
  + Support general administrative tasks and special projects as business needs evolve

**What we're looking for:**

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience in office management, executive assistance, workplace operations, or a similar role, ideally within a high-growth startup
* 2 years of experience directly supporting senior executives, including calendar management, meeting coordination, travel planning, and handling competing priorities
* 2 years of independently managing office operations or facilities, including vendor relationships and budgets
* Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through, with the ability to manage competing priorities effectively
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a polished and professional approach
* Sound judgment and the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion
* A proactive, hands-on mindset and the ability to anticipate needs, solve problems, and take initiative without waiting for direction
* Comfort operating in ambiguity and building processes in a fast-paced, evolving environment
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace
* Ability to work on-site in Palo Alto (3 days a week) and occasionally flex working hours to support teams across time zones

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting a global organization with teams across multiple countries
* Experience planning company events, offsites, and leadership retreats, including group travel logistics
* Familiarity with tools such as Greenhouse, Adobe Sign, Expensify, or similar platforms

**What you'll love:**

* **Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage:** 100% coverage for employees and 80% for their spouses and children
* **Health Reimbursement Account (HRA):** 100% funded by AiDASH to cover medical deductibles
* **401(k) Plan:** Begin contributing after two months of employment to prepare for your future. Currently, no company match is offered
* **Parental Leave:** Supportive parental leave with 16 weeks for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary caregivers
* **Generous Vacation Policy:** Accrue 20 vacation days per year, plus enjoy an additional flex holiday to celebrate whatever feels most important to you
* **Winter Break:** From December 25th through January 1st, we give everyone time off to recharge and enjoy

jobs.title: Club Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

At Claremont Resort & Club, we believe that exceptional hospitality starts with extraordinary people. For over a century, our iconic resort has set the standard for luxury and service in the Bay Area. We take pride in creating memorable experiences for our guests—and a rewarding, inclusive workplace for our colleagues. Situated on 22 acres in the Berkeley and Oakland Hills, Claremont Resort & Club seamlessly blends its rich 19th-century history with the modern day to offer the very best of the Bay Area. jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

When someone at Crusoe needs help with a People question, they should know exactly where to go and get a fast, accurate answer, whether they sit at a desk or work a shift on a manufacturing floor. You'll build that front door.

As the Senior People Operations Solutions Manager for HR Service Delivery, you are the product manager for how employees and managers get help: the People portal, case management, the knowledge platform, AI agents and the channels people use to reach us, from mobile and text to phone and on-site kiosks. AI and knowledge answer first, and people step in where judgment and care matter. Every case a person solves should make the knowledge, and the AI, better next time.

Reporting to the Director, People Operations Solutions you lead solution teams with Employee Care, the Knowledge Manager, Lifecycle Operations, UX design, analytics and IT. You'll bring a bias toward automation and AI, and the judgment to keep a human in the loop where it counts.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* Service delivery platform: own the roadmap for the People portal, case management and AI agent, from platform selection through launch and continuous improvement.
* Experience design: use design thinking to understand how employees and managers look for help, prototype with them, and design service journeys that work for desk-based and frontline teammates alike.
* Channels: design how people reach us across portal, chat, mobile, text, phone, AI voice and on-site kiosks, with live translation and simple sign-in for teammates without a company email or computer.
* Case management: design intake, routing, tiering and escalation so every request is tracked, owned and closed by the right team, and reaches the right expert with full context.
* Knowledge platform: with the Knowledge Manager, build the knowledge base and the practices that help content owners keep it accurate, so AI and self-service resolve more questions over time.
* AI and automation: design AI agents and automated workflows that answer questions and complete simple requests, with clear hand-offs to people and guardrails for sensitive matters.
* Service catalog: define and maintain the catalog of People services, with owners, tiers and service levels for each.
* Roadmap and delivery: own the backlog for service delivery products and deliver in short cycles with demos to business owners.
* Measurement and improvement: own product measures such as touchless resolution, end-user satisfaction, effort, service levels and cost to serve, and use the results to drive design improvements.
* Technology partnership: lead the work with IT using agile development practices, including a shared backlog, sprint planning, regular demos and joint testing. Translate requirements into configuration and integration decisions across the service platform, Workday, collaboration tools and identity.
* Launch and adoption: prepare readiness, enablement and adoption with Change Management and Employee Care for each release.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* We don't expect anyone to bring everything below. If you meet the requirements and some of the rest, we'd like to hear from you.
* **Required**

  + 8+ years in HR service delivery, employee experience, IT or HR service management, or product management for employee-service software, with several end-to-end launches
  + Process design skill: service blueprints, routing and escalation design, standard work and service levels
  + Comfort with service data: you set targets, read the trends and act on them
  + Energy for the pace of a fast-scaling company and a path not fully paved
* **Equivalent experience we value equally**

  + Service platform: implementing or running ServiceNow HRSD, or a comparable case and knowledge platform in HR, IT or customer service
  + Knowledge management: designing knowledge practices, ideally Knowledge-Centered Service, or KCS, ITIL or Lean Six Sigma training
  + AI: deploying conversational AI, chatbots or AI agents for employee or customer support, or designing automated workflows with clear hand-offs to people
  + Product delivery: design thinking and agile methods from business case through adoption, or product management at an HR service delivery, ITSM or customer-service software company

**Bonus Points**

* Serving deskless or hourly workforces, including kiosks, text and mobile channels
* Contact-center operations, telephony or AI voice experience
* Multilingual support and live translation

**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation and equity packages
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account
* Paid parental leave

Crusoe is growing fast across offices, data centers and manufacturing sites in several countries. How we set goals, review performance, develop our people and bring new talent in shapes how every employee experiences Crusoe, and how quickly they grow with us.

As Senior People Operations Solutions Manager for the talent lifecycle, you are the product manager for how Crusoe reviews, grows and hires its people. Your focus is the systems that enable talent performance cycle and ongoing talent development: goals, check-ins, mid-year and year-end reviews, calibration, learning and career growth. You also design the recruiting lifecycle in Ashby and Workday and its hand-off into onboarding. You start from the outcome the business needs, partner with Centers of Excellence, design with the employees and managers who use the process, and deliver a complete solution across people, process and technology.

Reporting to the Director, People Operations Solutions , you lead solution teams partnering with our Talent and Learning teams, Talent Acquisition, Lifecycle Operations, UX design, analytics and IT. You'll bring a bias toward automation and AI, and the judgment to add process where it creates value and keep it light where it doesn't.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* Talent performance cycle: partner with Talent and Performance Management to deliver the performance cycle end-to-end, owning the workflow, system configuration, cycle operations, and user experience, making each cycle simpler and more useful for employees and managers.
* Ongoing talent development: build the processes and tools that deliver learning, career paths, internal mobility and succession programs designed by the Talent and Learning teams, so growth at Crusoe is continuous, visible and easy to act on.
* Manager enablement: partner with Talent and Performance Management to give managers the tools, data and prompts to coach, recognize and develop their teams between formal cycles.

Translate requirements into configuration and integration decisions for Workday Talent, Performance and Learning, Workday Recruiting and Ashby, and the tools around them.
* Launch and adoption: prepare readiness, enablement and adoption with Change Management, and hand each product to Lifecycle Operations with clear standards.
* Measurement and improvement: enable tracking of measures such as cycle completion and quality, manager and employee satisfaction, internal mobility, time to hire and data quality, and keep improving after launch.
* Global scale: design for many countries, entities and sites, including manufacturing and data center teams.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

We don't expect anyone to bring everything below. If you meet the requirements and some of the rest, we'd like to hear from you.

### **Required**

* 8+ years in talent management, performance and development programs, HR technology or HR product management, with several end-to-end launches
* Deep knowledge of performance management and talent development processes
* Process design skill: journey and process mapping, standard work, SOPs and RACI
* Comfort with data: you define the measures and act on what they show
* The ability to lead without authority and build trust with managers, talent and learning partners, recruiters and IT
* Energy for the pace of a fast-scaling company and a path not fully paved

### **Equivalent experience we value equally**

* Talent technology: Workday Talent and Performance, or comparable depth in another talent management system
* Recruiting: an applicant tracking system such as Ashby or Workday Recruiting, or hands-on recruiting operations experience
* Product delivery: design thinking and agile methods from business case through adoption, or product management at a talent management, learning or HCM software company
* Process improvement: Lean, Six Sig

Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.  
  
Who We Are

We’re on a mission to make energy more reliable and affordable for more people. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs. Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses.

The Technical Operations Supervisor (TOS) reports directly to the Technical Operations Manager and is the front line leader for Technicians in the field. The TOS is responsible for ensuring that each Technician meets Sunrun operating standards for safety and performance.

----------------------

Range Energy builds powered trailers that help electrify heavy-duty trucking without requiring fleets to replace their tractors. We solve real-world problems with real hardware.

Founded in 2021, Range is led by experienced EV operators from Tesla, Zoox, Honda, and other leading OEMs. We are backed by strong investors and focused on building hardware that fleets will actually use.

The work is hands-on. Sometimes messy. Often fast. Always meaningful.

**What we look for in every hire:** Mission first. Team second. Self third.

**Winning attitude & ownership.** We move fast and hold a high bar for execution. You own the outcome, not just your piece of it. When the path isn’t clear, you find a way. And when you’re stuck, you ask for help early.

**Curiosity & humility.** You ask good questions, learn fast, and stay low ego. You put the mission and the people around you ahead of your own credit, stay open to feedback, and are quick to admit when you’re wrong.

**Integrity & trust.** You tell the truth, especially when it’s bad news. You keep your commitments, own your mistakes, and do what’s right. And you treat others the way you’d want to be treated.

If you like building real things, solving hard problems, and working with low-drama, high-output teammates, you’ll fit here.

**Role Summary**
----------------

As a Supply Chain Project Manager, you will combine strategic sourcing ownership with hands-on program management for Range’s supply chain function. You will hold the bill of materials accountable to cost targets end-to-end, run the day-to-day coordination across a multi-supplier base, and act as the connective tissue between sourcing, engineering, and manufacturing so that supplier commitments translate into on-time, on-cost delivery. This role suits someone equally comfortable negotiating a contract and running the project plan that keeps a dozen suppliers moving in lockstep.

* Negotiate favorable contractual terms and conditions with suppliers, including pricing, delivery schedules, quality requirements, and service levels.

* Continuously monitor and evaluate supplier performance against quality, delivery, and cost targets; implement corrective actions when necessary.
* Lead the day-to-day process of ensuring successful partnerships – milestone adherence, change order management, quality assurance, and cost control.
* Provide regular reports and analysis on sourcing metrics, program status, supplier performance, and cost savings to senior management.

---------------------------

* At least 5 years of experience in strategic sourcing, purchasing, and/or program management in a hardware product environment.
* Bachelor’s degree.
* Strategic sourcing, financial and business opportunity analysis, comfort with legal frameworks and contract negotiation skills (development, supply, licensing, and service agreements).
* Demonstrated experience running multi-workstream projects or programs – building and holding schedules, managing dependencies, and driving cross-functional accountability.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, including C-level, engineering, legal, finance, manufacturing, and logistics.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and work in a team environment.
* Demonstrated ability to identify business process issues and drive process improvement.
* Deep experience in complex project management.
* Uncanny ability to execute.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Haves**

* Advanced (Master’s, Doctorate, etc.) degree in business, operations, supply chain, or a related field.
* Experience in the electric vehicle industry.
* Experience with automotive component supply chain.
* PMP or similar project/program management certification.
* Mandarin-speaking ability is a plus.

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

* This role requires regular onsite presence at Range HQ in Mountain View.
* Physical Requirements: Ability to work in a shop environment, including standing for extended periods and occasionally lifting up to 50 pounds. Comfortable with occasional bending, kneeling, and climbing as required for infrastructure maintenance. Ability to sustain extended periods of sitting and computer usage.

jobs.title: Deployment Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Corvus**

We’re Corvus Robotics, a Physical AI company transforming how the world’s warehouses operate. By combining autonomous robotics, computer vision, and AI, we’re replacing manual, labor-intensive processes with intelligent systems that make inventory management safer, smarter, and more efficient.

Our flagship Corvus One drones autonomously track warehouse inventory around the clock, while Corvus Trident, our AI-powered forklift intelligence system, captures inventory movement in real time. Together, our technologies provide a complete picture of warehouse operations, helping enterprises improve accuracy, efficiency, and decision-making.

Our technology is widely deployed and delivering value for leading enterprises. We’re now building a future where warehouse operations are fully autonomous. At Corvus, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, solve challenging real-world problems, and help bring the next generation of intelligent robots to scale.

**About the Role**

At Corvus Robotics, we're scaling autonomous robotics across enterprise warehouses. We're looking for a Deployment Program Manager to own the end-to-end customer deployment process, from sales handoff through successful implementation and operational readiness.

You'll serve as the central point of coordination across Sales, Engineering, Customer Success, and field deployment teams, ensuring projects move efficiently from signed agreements to fully operational Corvus One systems.

This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives on ownership, cross-functional execution, and building scalable processes in a fast-growing robotics company.

**This field-based role requires approximately 20–30% travel** across the U.S., with occasional visits to our Mountain View headquarters. You'll work closely with customers and cross-functional teams to coordinate deployments, ensure site readiness, and drive successful implementations.

**What You'll Do**

* **Own end-to-end deployment programs:** Lead customer implementations from sales handoff through installation, commissioning, and operational handover.
* **Drive deployment planning:** Establish project timelines, milestones, resource requirements, and clear ownership across internal teams and customers.
* **Bridge Sales and Operations:** Translate customer commitments, site requirements, and commercial expectations into actionable deployment plans.
* **Coordinate cross-functional execution:** Partner with Sales, Engineering, Customer Success, and field teams to keep deployments on track.
* **Manage customer readiness:** Coordinate site assessments, infrastructure requirements, installation schedules, and customer dependencies.
* **Identify and resolve risks:** Proactively manage blockers, escalations, scope changes, and competing priorities to protect deployment timelines.
* **Build scalable processes:** Develop deployment playbooks, standardized workflows, and reporting to support growing deployment volumes.
* **Drive successful handoffs:** Ensure clear acceptance criteria, customer training, and a smooth transition to ongoing operations and support.

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience in technical program management, deployment management, implementation, or customer-facing operations.
* Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects from planning through execution.
* Experience coordinating hardware installations, robotics, industrial automation, or other technical deployments.
* Strong project planning, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate technical and business requirements into clear execution plans.
* Excellent communication skills and confidence working with enterprise customers and technical teams.
* A hands-on, highly organized approach with the ability to drive accountability and execution in a fast-paced startup environment.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in robotics, warehouse automation, industrial IoT, or hardware-software integrated systems.
* Background managing enterprise customer implementations or multi-site rollouts.
* Familiarity with warehouse operations, logistics, networking, or site infrastructure.
* Experience developing deployment playbooks, operational KPIs, and scalable processes.
* Experience working closely with Sales during pre-deployment planning and post-sales handoffs.

**Why Join Corvus Robotics?**

**Build technology that works in the real world.** Be part of a team bringing autonomous robotics and AI into real-world environments, solving meaningful challenges and transforming warehouse operations.

**Own your impact.** Take ownership of meaningful work, contribute to important decisions, and see the direct impact of your contributions as we grow.

**Help scale the next generation of Physical AI.** Join at a pivotal stage of growth and help build the technology, teams, systems, and processes that will bring autonomous robotics to enterprise scale.

**Grow alongside the company.** Work with talented, driven people across disciplines, tackle new challenges, expand your skills, and help shape the future of Corvus Robotics.

Compensation Range: $110K - $140K

**Company Description**

WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy.

As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in.

We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.

This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.

We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.

Join us and let’s shape the future of data.

 **Job Description**

The E2E Planning Transformation Functional Program Manager is the program execution anchor for Western Digital's supply chain planning transformation portfolio. Reporting to the Vice President of Supply Chain Planning, this role drives cross-functional program management across the full suite of strategic transformation initiatives — from Kinaxis RapidResponse enablement and S&OP process redesign to LRP automation and Capital planning improvements. You design and own the Management Operating Structure of Supply Chain Planning & Capital group: initiative delivery, operational review infrastructure, business value realization, and organizational health tracking — not just status reporting.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

1. Operational Review Infrastructure

Enable and organize the operational review cadence that feeds into key executive reviews — including Quarterly Business Reviews, annual planning cycles, and transformation portfolio reviews. Own the structure, preparation, content quality, and follow-through for each review gate so leadership always has a decision-ready view of the business.

2. Balanced Scorecard Creation & Operationalization

Help structure and operationalize a Balanced Scorecard for Supply Chain Planning and Capital — defining the right metrics across financial, operational, transformation, and talent dimensions. jobs.title: Patient Services and Consult Coordinator
jobs.description:
#### **POSITION SUMMARY**

The Patient Services and Consult Coordinator serves as the first point of contact for patients, families, referring offices, and visitors at the front desk, and as the primary point of contact for prospective patients from initial inquiry through the surgical consultation. At the front desk, this role manages check-in and check-out, patient registration, eligibility and benefits verification, scheduling, phones, and patient payments, keeping clinic sessions running on time. In the consult role, it reviews new patient inquiries, referrals, and intake submissions to confirm that required paperwork and documentation are complete; schedules consultations; and coordinates with providers, insurance verification, and financial counseling so that patients arrive at their consultation informed and prepared. Once a patient has completed the consultation and is confirmed to proceed with a surgical course, the coordinator completes a documented handoff to the Surgery Coordinator, who manages the patient through surgery scheduling, surgery, and postoperative follow-up. This is a nonclinical position; it does not include rooming patients, clinical assessment, triage, medical advice, medical decision-making, or tasks performed by medical assistants or licensed clinical staff.

#### **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Front Desk: General reception, front desk, and checking in patients responsibilities
* Consult Coordination: Serve as the primary point of contact for prospective and new patients from initial inquiry through completion of the surgical consultation.
* Consult Coordination: Respond to new patient inquiries, referrals, and intake submissions received by phone, email, patient portal, in person, or other approved channels within established response timelines.
* Consult Coordination: Explain the practice’s intake and consultation process, required documentation, general timelines, and what patients can expect before and after their consultation.
* Consult Coordination: Distribute, collect, and review intake packets, referral submissions, health history forms, financial policy acknowledgments, and the Notice of Privacy Practices acknowledgment for completeness, confirming receipt of required items such as demographic information, insurance information, identification, intake and consent forms, medical records, and letters of support or referral, as required by practice protocols and payer requirements.
* Consult Coordination: Identify missing, incomplete, expired, or inconsistent documentation and follow up with patients, referring providers, and outside offices to obtain it within established timelines.
* Consult Coordination: Route documentation requiring clinical review to the appropriate provider or clinical staff. The coordinator confirms that documents are present and complete but does not evaluate their clinical content or adequacy.
* Consult Coordination: Coordinate with insurance verification and financial counseling to confirm that eligibility, benefits, and any consultationrelated referral or authorization requirements are addressed before the consultation.
* Consult Coordination: Schedule, confirm, and reschedule inperson and telehealth consultations, and send appointment details, preconsultation instructions, and reminders.
* Consult Coordination: Serve as a liaison between assigned providers and prospective patients during the preconsultation stage for nonclinical questions, scheduling, and documentation needs.
* Consult Coordination: Conduct regular checkins with patients during the preconsultation period to keep them informed of outstanding requirements and next steps.
* Consult Coordination: Track each prospective patient’s status from inquiry through consultation, and maintain an accurate, current consult pipeline in the appropriate systems.
* Consult Coordination: Following the consultation, confirm the provider’s documented outcome and communicate nonclinical next steps to the patient.
* Consult Coordination: For patients confirmed to proceed with a surgical course, complete a timely, documented handoff to the Surgery Coordinator, including documentation status, any outstanding items, and relevant patient communication preferences.
* Consult Coordination: For patients who are not proceeding, or who must complete additional requirements before proceeding, communicate next steps as directed by the provider and document the patient’s status accordingly.
* Records: Scan, index, and file incoming records, faxes, and outside reports to the correct patient chart; route requests for release of medical records to the designated staff member in accordance with HIPAA, the California Confidentiality of Medical Information Act, and practice policy.
* Records: Accurately document patient communication, checkin and payment activity, documentation review, status updates, and completed milestones in the appropriate systems.
* Communicate outstanding requirements, scheduling changes, and next steps clearly and compassionately.
* Escalate complex patient concerns, documentation barriers, or operational issues to the appropriate department or leader.
* Protect the confidentiality of protected health information (PHI) at the front desk, on the phone, and in written and electronic communications, including when requesting and receiving records from outside providers; follow minimumnecessary standards and report suspected privacy incidents promptly.
* Provide respectful, compassionate, and genderaffirming support without providing clinical advice, medical education, or medical decisionmaking.
* Maintain regular and reliable attendance sufficient to meet the position’s operational, patientservice, and team obligations, with or without reasonable accommodation.
* Comply with applicable laws, regulations, accreditation requirements, privacy and security standards, financial controls, and organizational policies relevant to the position.
* Other duties as assigned.

The essential fun

**About the Role**
------------------

The **Program Manager, Clinical Trials** will run the day-to-day work of every agentic AI clinical trial we conduct, across **pre-trial, active trial, and post-trial** phases. You will work with internal clinical, research, regulatory, and engineering teams, and serve as the main operational contact for CROs and health system partners. You will be accountable for the success of each clinical program.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Pre-Trial**

* Work with clinical and research leads on study design, protocols, endpoints, and data collection strategy, including CRFs, EDC, and AI agent interaction data.
* Select and manage CROs and vendors: scopes of work, budgets, and contracts.
* Engage health system partners on site feasibility, contracting, and study startup.
* Coordinate IRB submissions, informed consent, data use agreements, and HIPAA reviews.
* Build integrated study plans covering timelines, milestones, resourcing, and risks.

### **During Trial**

* Manage daily trial operations across sites, CROs, and internal teams so studies stay on schedule, on budget, and on protocol.

* Coordinate trial logistics, including AI agent deployment with engineering, site training, and study materials.
* Make sure adverse events and AI-related safety escalations are tracked and reported according to protocol.
* Report progress, risks, and needed decisions to leadership.

### **Post-Trial**

* Lead close-out activities: database lock, site close-out, and vendor reconciliation.
* Support clinical study reports, regulatory submissions (e.g., FDA 510(k) or De Novo), and publications.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the team and role**
---------------------------

Ramp’s Strategic Lifecycle Success team helps our largest and most complex customers turn their investment in Ramp into lasting business impact. After initial onboarding and implementation are complete, we help customers deepen adoption, continuously improve their Ramp setup, and successfully launch and activate additional products as their needs evolve.

As a Strategic Lifecycle Customer Success Manager, you’ll be a hands-on product expert and trusted partner to the finance, accounting, and operations teams using Ramp. You’ll own the ongoing customer success plan, proactively improve workflows, and lead onboarding and implementation when existing customers adopt new Ramp products. You’ll also lead adoption and value-focused business reviews, connecting how customers use Ramp to the outcomes that matter to their business.

You’ll work alongside an Account Manager, who owns commercial strategy and executive relationships, and partner with Solutions Consultants and Technical Consultants on complex technical needs. Your focus is helping customers get more from Ramp over time—from optimizing what’s already live to making each new product rollout successful.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* **Own ongoing success planning for a portfolio of customers.** After a structured handoff from initial onboarding and implementation, partner with a dedicated Account Manager to align on customer goals and define clear milestones, owners, and measures of success.
* **Serve as a trusted Ramp product expert.** Stay current on new products, capabilities, and best practices, and proactively translate relevant releases into recommendations for each customer.
* **Continuously enhance customers’ Ramp environments.** Understand their configuration and business processes, identify opportunities to improve policies, controls, approval flows, and workflows, and work hands-on with customers to put those improvements into practice.
* **Lead new-product implementations for existing customers.** Own discovery, planning, configuration, training, launch, and sustained adoption, aligning customer goals, owners, and milestones. Lead standard workflow improvements; partner with Solutions Consultants on complex design and validation, Technical Consultants on integrations, APIs, ERP connections, and data flows, and Support on troubleshooting and defect escalation. Specialists own diagnosis and execution; you own customer communication, cross-functional follow-through, and validation of outcomes.
* **Lead adoption and value-focused business reviews.** Define success measures and establish baselines with customers, then track improvements in adoption, spend consolidation, operational efficiency, and controls to demonstrate the value of their Ramp investment. Run regular adoption reviews with day-to-day stakeholders and partner with the Account Manager on executive QBRs and EBRs. Bring in the Account Manager or Solutions Consultant when useful, and coordinate joint reviews for Tier 1 accounts. Use evidence of progress to agree on next priorities.
* **Build customer champions and drive change.** Develop a network of champions across finance, accounting, AP, operations, and business units. Create enablement and change-management plans, including train-the-trainer approaches where useful, that equip customer teams to adopt new capabilities and sustain new ways of working beyond individual stakeholders.
* **Manage customer health proactively.** Monitor adoption, engagement, outcomes, and delivery risks; identify barriers early; and lead action plans to improve customer health. Equip your Account Manager with value evidence for renewal and growth conversations.
* **Identify customer success qualified leads (CSQLs).** Recognize growth signals through customer relationships, product usage, and evolving business needs, and qualify and proactively surface expansion opportunities to your Account Manager with clear customer context, value evidence, and recommended next steps. The Account Manager owns commercial strategy and execution.
* **Shape a repeatable lifecycle success motion.** Partner with Solutions Consultants, Technical Consultants, Support, and Product to resolve blockers and build playbooks for ongoing optimization and new-product activation. Translate recurring customer needs and workflow gaps into actionable feedback for Product, and close the loop with customers on relevant developments without making unconfirmed roadmap commitments.

**What you need**
-----------------

* A track record in enterprise customer success, including hands-on ownership of implementation, adoption, and ongoing value realization for complex customers.
* Strong product aptitude and experience configuring and optimizing software to support customer business processes—not just advising from a distance.
* Experience managing customer-facing implementations, from discovery and project planning through training, launch, and sustained adoption.

jobs.title: Customer Success Lead
jobs.description:
**About Bobyard**

Construction is a multi-trillion-dollar industry facing a shortage of roughly 349,000 workers — and it still estimates by hand. Contractors spend weeks measuring and counting materials off drawings, and that caps how many jobs they can bid. Bobyard’s AI takes a contractor from a set of plans to a bid in minutes instead of weeks. Our customers run real construction jobs on Bobyard, not demos. We raised a $35M Series A led by 8VC, with Primary and Pear.

**Who we are**

Builders. We ship real product to real contractors. If it doesn’t survive contact with a live job, it doesn’t count — we don’t do demo-ware.

Owners. There’s no layer between you and the problem, and no permission slip required. When you see the solution, you own it, end to end.

Independent minds. Strong convictions, open minds. We hire for how you think, not where you learned it — show us the work, not the résumé.

Fast movers. We decide quickly and optimize for impact, not consensus. You’ll be judged by the people in the problem with you, on what you deliver.

**About the role**

Our CSM team is growing faster than one leader can coach. You'll lead a pod of Customer Success Managers, own their retention and expansion numbers, and build the playbook the next pods will run on. You'll still take the hardest accounts yourself.

**What you'll do**

* Lead, coach, and hire a pod of CSMs, and set the bar for what good looks like
* Own your pod's gross and net revenue retention, and know where every account stands each week
* Spot stalling accounts early, and run the save plan yourself when it matters
* Drive renewals, upsells, and win-backs with your team
* Take customers from Implementation without a gap, and turn their feedback into product fixes with Product
* Build the coverage model, health signals, and dashboards that show where to hire and what to automate
* Jump on the hardest customer calls, from estimators to owners

**What we're looking for**

* 6+ years in B2B SaaS customer success or account management, with 2+ years leading CSMs
* You've managed hundreds of SMB or mid-market accounts, not a dozen whales
* You know your team's GRR, NRR, and churn cold, and can show what you personally moved
* Commercial instinct. You're comfortable owning renewal and expansion targets
* You coach in the details: call reviews, account plans, weekly numbers
* Comfortable training non-technical field users

**Nice to have**

* Construction, trades, or field-service software experience
* Built customer success operations on HubSpot and Intercom
* Scaled a CS team through a period of fast growth

**A note on pace**

We move fast, and priorities shift as we learn from customers. Playbooks, context, and requirements are often incomplete when work starts, and you'll be expected to shape them. If that pace excites you, you'll fit in well.

**What we offer**

Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver, and it grows as you do.

* 170,000–190,000 base + bonus tied to retention and expansion + 0.03%–0.05% equity — pending HM confirmation
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4%
* Catered lunch in the office and $70 a month toward your commute
* Full-time, in person at our San Francisco office (101 2nd Street), 4 days a week.

Come build with us!

Compensation Range: $170K - $190K

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Customer Success
jobs.description:
**Why we're hiring**
--------------------

Harper is an AI-native commercial insurance brokerage. Our product is the operating system our own teams run on: voice AI intake, placements, instant quoting, sales, service and retention, plus the operator tools that tie them together. Each module has engineers, a forward-deployed pod and operators who live in it every day, but not enough product ownership to decide what to build, measure whether it worked, and keep the module coherent as it scales. This hire closes that gap. Each PM becomes the single owner of a module's outcomes: its KPIs, its roadmap and the operator experience inside it.

**Experience:** 5–8 years. **Scope:** Service (Customer Success)  
  
**About the role**

You own a product area that spans more than one team and more than one quarter. Nobody hands you the problem list; you find the problems worth solving, decide which to bet on, and are accountable for the outcome even when the work runs through several pods.

Service is the clearest example. It touches endorsements, certificates, renewals, billing and claims support, and today a lot of it runs on human effort. The Senior PM decides what gets productized, what stays operator-owned, and in what order.

### **What you'll own**

* **Outcomes, not features.** Propose the KPI set for your area and defend why those are the right targets. At least one should trace to a company top-line number (revenue, retention, cost per policy).
* **A 3–6 month roadmap** with clear bets, sequencing and kill criteria.
* **Growth avenues.** Look past optimizing today's funnel: new segments, use cases, or ways to expand revenue per account.
* **Cross-team delivery.** Break initiatives into plans other people can execute; chase dependencies directly; re-plan out loud the moment reality changes.
* **Ops partnership.** Be embedded enough that operators treat you as a peer on process. Turn recurring operational pain into bets with clear ROI.
* **Raising the bar.** Mentor the PM on specs and prioritization; own a stage of the PM interview loop.

  **Logistics**
  -------------

  + **Compensation:** $125,000–$170,000 base + performance bonus + equity.
  + **Location:** San Francisco, in-office. Based here or willing to relocate.
  + **Benefits:** Uber commuter benefits; breakfast, lunch, and dinner provided; snacks and coffee stocked; free gym membership; health, dental, and vision.

  **To apply:** Commercial insurance has never been rebuilt, and the gap between what frontier models make possible and what's actually shipped in this industry is the largest it will ever be. If you want to own a module that touches real customers from week one — send your resume and tell us about something you built that moved a number.

Compensation Range: $125K - $170K

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Nimble:**
-----------------

Nimble is the company leading the AI web search category. Our products are used by leading businesses in financial services, retail, market intelligence, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with accurate, auditable programmatic access to the web.

We've raised over $70 million from Norwest, Databricks Ventures, Target Global, Square Peg, and others to build expert-level web search for AI. Hundreds of enterprise customers already run on Nimble, and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, researchers, designers, marketers, sellers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

**Why join Nimble?**

* Work on a deeply technical platform powering real-time AI and enterprise decisions
* Help define the future of Web Search Agents and live web intelligence
* Build alongside a sharp, mission-driven team that moves fast, ships often, and takes ownership

**About the Role:**
-------------------

Nimble is hiring an **Enterprise Account Manager** to own retention and revenue growth across a portfolio of enterprise customers.

You will lead the commercial relationship from post-sale handoff through renewal and expansion, building a deep understanding of customers’ technical priorities and translating measurable value into growing partnerships.

This is a hands-on, quota-carrying role that combines strategic account management, enterprise selling, and customer advocacy. You will work closely with technical stakeholders and executive buyers to identify new use cases, expand adoption, and negotiate agreements that support long-term growth.

**What You’ll be Doing:**
-------------------------

* **Own customer growth, retention, and NRR targets** across your portfolio, with direct accountability for renewals and existing-customer revenue growth.
* **Manage renewal and expansion opportunities from discovery through close**, including qualification, proposals, negotiation, and procurement.
* **Build and execute strategic account plans** that connect customer priorities with new use cases, broader adoption, and revenue opportunities.
* **Develop relationships across each account**, engaging technical users, internal champions, executive sponsors, and economic buyers.
* **Identify and develop expansion opportunities** by understanding customers’ workflows, business objectives, and unmet needs.
* **Lead business reviews** that demonstrate measurable value, align on customer priorities, and establish clear next steps.
* **Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast**, with visibility into renewal timing, expansion potential, commercial risks, and actions needed to close.
* **Identify and address retention risks early**, coordinating with Solutions, Product, and Engineering to resolve barriers to customer value.
* **Partner with Sales on customer handoffs** to establish continuity around commitments, stakeholder relationships, and growth potential.
* **Help build the Account Management motion**, contributing practical account planning templates, renewal processes, and expansion playbooks.

**What You Should Have for the Role:**
--------------------------------------

* **3+ years in enterprise SaaS Account Management, Sales, or commercially accountable Customer Success roles.**
* A proven record of **meeting or exceeding renewal and expansion quotas**, with direct ownership of commercial outcomes.
* Experience managing **complex enterprise accounts**, including multiple stakeholders, procurement processes, and contract negotiations.
* Strong discovery and account planning skills, with the ability to turn customer needs into qualified opportunities and closed revenue.
* Experience working with **technical stakeholders**, such as Data, AI, Engineering, or BI teams, and connecting technical capabilities to business value.
* Strong commercial judgment, including the ability to navigate pricing discussions, handle objections, and negotiate agreements.
* Discipline in pipeline management, CRM hygiene, and revenue forecasting.
* Clear communication and the ability to build credibility with both technical teams and executive buyers.
* Comfort working in a startup environment, balancing portfolio ownership with the opportunity to help build a growing function.

**Job Summary:**

The Community Health Worker (CHW) is an essential member of Cardea Health’s clinical team, supporting residents of Cardea Health interim housing programs who are enrolled in Behavioral Health Bridge Housing (BHBH). BHBH residents are living with complex medical, behavioral health, and social needs and often require intensive individualized support to reach their clinical and housing goals. * Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport with diverse populations

**Preferred Qualifications:**
