jobs.title: Senior People Operations Solutions Manager, Talent Lifecycle
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

Crusoe is growing fast across offices, data centers and manufacturing sites in several countries. How we set goals, review performance, develop our people and bring new talent in shapes how every employee experiences Crusoe, and how quickly they grow with us.

As Senior People Operations Solutions Manager for the talent lifecycle, you are the product manager for how Crusoe reviews, grows and hires its people. Your focus is the systems that enable talent performance cycle and ongoing talent development: goals, check-ins, mid-year and year-end reviews, calibration, learning and career growth. You also design the recruiting lifecycle in Ashby and Workday and its hand-off into onboarding. You start from the outcome the business needs, partner with Centers of Excellence, design with the employees and managers who use the process, and deliver a complete solution across people, process and technology.

Reporting to the Director, People Operations Solutions , you lead solution teams partnering with our Talent and Learning teams, Talent Acquisition, Lifecycle Operations, UX design, analytics and IT. You'll bring a bias toward automation and AI, and the judgment to add process where it creates value and keep it light where it doesn't.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* Talent performance cycle: partner with Talent and Performance Management to deliver the performance cycle end-to-end, owning the workflow, system configuration, cycle operations, and user experience, making each cycle simpler and more useful for employees and managers.
* Ongoing talent development: build the processes and tools that deliver learning, career paths, internal mobility and succession programs designed by the Talent and Learning teams, so growth at Crusoe is continuous, visible and easy to act on.
* Manager enablement: partner with Talent and Performance Management to give managers the tools, data and prompts to coach, recognize and develop their teams between formal cycles.
* Recruiting lifecycle: own the recruiting workflow across Ashby and Workday, from requisition to offer accepted, and its connection to onboarding, including the candidate portal.
* Discovery and outcomes: define success with program owners and the people who use the process. Map the current journey, measure it and find the constraints.
* Solution design: use design thinking to frame the problem and prototype with employees and managers. Then design future-state journeys across people, process and technology, including service blueprints, standard work, controls and where AI or automation should take on manual work.
* Roadmap and delivery: own the roadmap and backlog for talent lifecycle products, and deliver in short cycles with demos to business owners.
* Technology partnership: lead the work with IT using agile development practices, including a shared backlog, sprint planning, regular demos and joint testing. Translate requirements into configuration and integration decisions for Workday Talent, Performance and Learning, Workday Recruiting and Ashby, and the tools around them.
* Launch and adoption: prepare readiness, enablement and adoption with Change Management, and hand each product to Lifecycle Operations with clear standards.
* Measurement and improvement: enable tracking of measures such as cycle completion and quality, manager and employee satisfaction, internal mobility, time to hire and data quality, and keep improving after launch.
* Global scale: design for many countries, entities and sites, including manufacturing and data center teams.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

We don't expect anyone to bring everything below. If you meet the requirements and some of the rest, we'd like to hear from you.

### **Required**

* 8+ years in talent management, performance and development programs, HR technology or HR product management, with several end-to-end launches
* Deep knowledge of performance management and talent development processes
* Process design skill: journey and process mapping, standard work, SOPs and RACI
* Comfort with data: you define the measures and act on what they show
* The ability to lead without authority and build trust with managers, talent and learning partners, recruiters and IT
* Energy for the pace of a fast-scaling company and a path not fully paved

### **Equivalent experience we value equally**

* Talent technology: Workday Talent and Performance, or comparable depth in another talent management system

jobs.description:

Help shape how business clients start their relationship with JPMorganChase. Join our collaborative Digital Onboarding Client Experiences and Solutions product team, where you'll turn complex onboarding, KYC, and account setup steps into simple, fast, digital experiences. Work alongside experienced product managers, designers, and engineers to define user journeys and bring them to life in experiences that clients notice from day one.

You partner closely with designers to shape the end-to-end user journey, and with engineering teams to turn that vision into well-defined epics, user stories, and working features. We are seeking an experienced Training Program Manager to support the development, implementation, and ongoing management of training programs supporting Uber's Autonomous Mobility & Delivery operations. This role requires a strong understanding of training program development, instructional methodologies, and competency-based assessments, ideally within autonomous vehicles, transportation, or other safety-critical operational environments.  
  
The successful candidate will have experience developing and managing structured training programs that prepare operational staff to safely and effectively perform operational responsibilities. This includes developing training curricula, establishing qualification and certification requirements, implementing recurrent training, and evaluating training effectiveness through measurable performance outcomes.  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for building and maintaining training programs that can be executed by Uber and its external fleet operators and staffing partners. You will work closely with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, and external partners to ensure training reflects vehicle capabilities, operational procedures, and evolving business requirements. This role will also support the qualification of instructors, oversight of training delivery, and continuous improvement of training programs as our deployments with our autonomous vehicle partners expand across markets.  
  
This is a highly cross-functional role requiring strong program management, stakeholder engagement, and the ability to translate complex technical and operational requirements into practical, scalable training solutions.  
  
**What you’ll do:**

jobs.title: Business Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**The job**
-----------

Enable Honey Homes’ growth by building scalable systems to make each member’s perceived Honey Homes experience exceptional. The long-term metric output is increasing retention and member satisfaction.

This is a new position at Honey Homes, reporting to the CEO and sitting on the Senior Leadership team. Informed by analysis and the broader team’s input, the Business Operations Lead will identify leading indicator metrics that will increase retention and build structural, scalable systems to improve those metrics. Former founders, general managers, consultants, investment bankers, or bizops leaders would thrive in this role.

The scope of this role is intentionally broad to allow for unfettered exploration of impactful work and flexibility in adjusting scope and focus at any time to maximally benefit Honey Homes’ members.

Honey Homes’ mission is to replace the hassle of home upkeep with comfort and joy. This is a hard problem, but a valuable one to tackle. Our work is a complex and intensive journey spanning software, AI, human labor, and consumer preferences. Getting it right unlocks tremendous value for homeowners, and creates thousands of American jobs. We’re a small and mighty team who enjoy working together, backed by top-tier investors.

**Outcomes and Competencies**
-----------------------------

* **12-month Outcomes**

  + **Increase Retention:** Meaningfully lift monthly-cohort renewal rate from Year 1 to Year 2

    - **Every visit is excellent in the member’s eyes:** Every scheduled visit exceeds the members expectations by showing up on time, being prepared, completing tasks, clear communication when the unknown becomes known, and proactive follow up.
    - **Stay connected with members between visits:** Member chats that need a human answer are tackled quickly, and drive improvement of our AI assistant’s capabilities in partnership with Product
    - **Handyman supply is always available:** Recruiting pipeline delivers a hire-ready, vetted handyman in every market ahead of growth needs.
    - **Training sets up new handymen for success:** Rebuild handyman onboarding so each new hire cohort rapidly achieves our quality metrics.
    - **Launch holistic fixes to hit goals:** Solve problems with structural programs that address large swaths of challenges in one go.
    - **Hire teammates to support growth:** Identify what needs focus and support, dive in to understand it, build it, and get someone else (or AI) to own it going forward.
* **Competencies**

  + **You solve problems from first principles.** You’re excited to solve problems in innovative ways, and you resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking
  + **You prioritize all day long.** You understand what's the most important thing to be working on for the long-term benefit of our members, and make sure it gets done.
  + **You’re unafraid of ambiguity.** Rapid change and learning is exciting to you, and you thrive in ambiguous, startup environments
  + **You’re analytical.** You let data win arguments. You are a data-first problem solver with excellent Excel / data analysis skills.
  + **You document everything.** You build repeatable playbooks that are continually improved. You share clear, concise and frequent updates with your team.
  + **You’re relentless.** You do what it takes to win, no matter what
  + **You’re a proven leader.** You have hired great people in the past, and managed high-performing teams. You effectively collaborate with partners across the company at all levels.
  + **You are passionate about recruiting:** You understand that hiring is a key part of any role, and you foster a culture of always-on recruiting.
  + **You act like an owner.** You do what it takes to support our members throughout the year.
  + **Curious quick study.** When you hear - 1/2" Angle Stop - you ask what that is, and add it to your personal dictionary. Same for processes and ways to solve problems.
  + **You're technical enough.** You use AI to accelerate your work, and expand your impact. You can understand the evolving constraints on building product, and work directly with engineers on new product that directly affects your goals.
  + **You energize others.** Your attitude and leadership brings others with you on the journey every day. You create more leaders with the same zeal that you have.

*We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.*

Support

Akicita Federal, a tribally owned SBA 8(a) federal contractor, is pursuing a Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) contract supporting the National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS) National Vital Statistics System. The contract delivers manual ICD-10 cause-of-death coding for mortality and fetal death records that cannot be coded by NCHS's automated system. We are seeking a Program Manager to lead a remote team of nosologists (mortality coders) and serve as the primary point of contact for the CDC Contracting Officer and COR.

*This position is contingent upon contract award. Selected candidates will be named in our proposal as Key Personnel.*

* Recruit, schedule, supervise, and retain a distributed part-time coding team; manage replacements to keep continuity of service
* Track monthly production against purchased record volumes (minimum 16,500 records/month in the base year; 25,000–45,000 expected) and per-coder error rates (< 4%)
* Coordinate quality review batches (2-week turnaround) and validation coding for the automated coding system (1-week turnaround)
* Manage the staff roster, background investigations, Designated Agent Agreements, confidentiality training certificates, and security/privacy compliance
* Oversee timekeeping and payroll inputs in compliance with the Service Contract Labor Standards; support monthly invoicing by accepted record

**Required qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree (health information management, public health, business, or related field), or equivalent experience
* 5+ years managing federal contracts or production teams, including at least 3 years leading remote or distributed staff
* Experience managing quality and productivity metrics for coding, abstraction, data-entry, or similar production work
* Working knowledge of federal contractor requirements: PIV/HSPD-12, background investigations, and data confidentiality/privacy rules
* Ability to obtain and maintain a federal Public Trust background investigation and HHS PIV card
* U.S. citizenship or eligibility to obtain the required federal background investigation
* Strong written communication for government reporting

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience on CDC, NCHS, state vital statistics, or other public health data programs
* Familiarity with ICD-10 mortality coding / nosology or the NCHS coding systems
* Service Contract Labor Standards (SCA) payroll compliance experience
* PMP, RHIA, or similar certification

jobs.title: Claims Operations Associate
jobs.description:
#### **About us**

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

#### **About the role**

Coalition's Claims Operations team is the first step in every claim. Before a handler can work a file, we set it up, route it and make sure the insured and broker hear from us quickly.

The Claims Operations Associate keeps that front door running across every line of business and every country we serve. You'll handle intake, claim setup and payments at high volume, and you'll help us test and adopt the automation that will change how this work gets done.

You'll work closely with claims handlers and managers, brokers, policyholders and our vendor partners. This role reports to the Senior Manager, Claims Operations.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
RedSeal, a pioneer in preemptive exposure management and winner of the SC Award for Best CTEM Solution, helps organizations see, understand, and secure their hybrid digital environments across IT (on-prem, cloud, and remote workers), OT, and IoT. By dynamically modeling the entire environment, RedSeal uncovers hidden assets, misconfigurations, and lateral attack paths, prioritizes exposures based on business-critical impact with Risk Radius™, and continuously validates compliance with internal policies and industry standards. Trusted by hundreds of Fortune 1000 companies and more than 75 U.S. government agencies, including all five branches of the U.S. military, RedSeal strengthens resilience, streamlines operations, and reduces business risk. Learn more at www.redseal.net.  
  
**The Role**  
RedSeal is looking for a Technical Account Manager to serve as the trusted technical advisor for a portfolio of enterprise and government customers. You will own the post-sale technical relationship: guiding adoption, resolving technical issues, and helping customers turn RedSeal’s exposure management platform into measurable risk reduction. This is a customer-facing, technically demanding role for someone who is comfortable leading conversations with security leadership and equally at home troubleshooting a customer’s hybrid network architecture.  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the technical relationship for a portfolio of enterprise and government accounts, serving as the primary point of contact for adoption, escalations, and account health, and building relationships with security and network leadership through renewal.
* Guide customers through onboarding, deployment, and integration of RedSeal across hybrid environments spanning IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT.
* Build deep expertise in exposure management, in the security and infrastructure stack of every customer you support, and in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) as a strategic program so you can advise customers on best practice.
* Translate customer business objectives into technical success plans and track progress against measurable outcomes such as reduced exposures and improved compliance posture.
* Lead resolution of technical escalations for your accounts, coordinating with Support, Engineering, and Product and keeping customers informed with clear, timely communication.
* Deliver regular business reviews that connect RedSeal usage to risk reduction, audit readiness, and other outcomes that matter to the customer.
* Contribute to renewal and expansion forecasting for your accounts, identifying opportunities and risks early and partnering with Sales and Customer Success leadership on account strategy.
* Advocate internally for customer needs, feeding field insights back to Product Management and Engineering.
* Help onboard newer team members and contribute to team playbooks and technical enablement content.
* Speak confidently to hybrid environment modeling, attack path analysis, and Risk Radius™ prioritization in customer conversations.

  
**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years in a Technical Account Manager, Sales Engineer, Professional Services, or similar customer-facing technical role, including experience managing a portfolio of enterprise or government accounts; ideally in cybersecurity or network infrastructure.
* Strong working knowledge of enterprise networking (routing, switching, firewalls).
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to move between business-level risk conversations and hands-on technical troubleshooting.
* Experience handling technical escalations calmly and clearly, from triage through resolution.
* Experience with vulnerability management, compliance frameworks (e.g., NIST, PCI DSS, NERC-CIP, CMMC), or attack surface/exposure management tools is a strong plus.
* A proactive, ownership-driven mindset; you see problems before customers do and act on them.
* Willingness to travel periodically for on-site customer engagements.
* Eligibility for public trust or security clearance may be required for certain government accounts.
* Relevant certification (e.g., CISSP, Security+, CCNP, a cloud security credential, or an ICS/OT-specific credential) preferred.

  
**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYMENT**  
RedSeal is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

Career Team is a leading workforce development organization on a mission to transform lives. We blend cutting-edge technology with compassionate, high-touch services to drive real, measurable outcomes in the lives of job seekers across the country. At Career Team, we're solving today's unemployment challenges with smart software, world-class trainers, dedicated case managers, dynamic job developers, and innovative partners. If you're passionate about making a difference and believe in the power of technology to transform lives, you'll feel right at home here.

**TITLE** Senior Project Manager

**REPORTS TO** VP of Project Management

**LOCATION** Remote

**EMPLOYMENT TYPE** Full-Time, Exempt Employee

***We're replacing the software and delivery practices that workforce systems have run on for decades, one state agency at a time. This role is responsible for leading those implementations.*** **Career Edge** is a fully integrated career readiness and case management software system supporting workforce and education entities. Our goal is sustained employment for career seekers, real results for employers, and stronger communities. We sell and implement enterprise software to state agencies and large workforce systems, and our reputation depends on whether those implementations succeed.

As a Senior Project Manager, you'll lead complex, enterprise-level client implementations from concept through go-live, working closely with a cross-functional delivery team. We focus on two things in particular.

**First, domain depth.** Our best PMs learn the client's domain well enough to hold their own with subject-matter experts, and they use that knowledge to make better project decisions. Workforce experience is a plus but not required. You do need a track record of learning an unfamiliar industry's rules and workflows and leading complex delivery in it.

**Second, comfort with an evolving PMO.** We are growing quickly and still building our PMO, and this role is focused on delivery while that work continues. You follow the process where it exists, find a practical way forward where it doesn't yet, and then adopt the standard once it is in place. If you've only ever delivered inside an established PMO, with governance handed to you, a template for every artifact, and a senior owner for every escalation, this role may not be a good fit.

**What You'll Own**

jobs.description:
**Associate Project Manager**

**Location:** Denver, CO or Remote (US)

At Enverus, we’re committed to empowering the global quality of life by helping our customers make energy affordable and accessible to the world.

We are the most trusted energy-dedicated SaaS company, with a platform built to maximize value from generative AI, and our innovative solutions are reshaping the way energy is consumed and managed. By offering anytime, anywhere access to analytics and insights, we’re helping our customers make better decisions that help provide communities around the world with clean, affordable energy.

The energy industry is changing fast. But we’ve continued to lead the way in energy technology, creating intelligent connections across the entire energy ecosystem, from renewables, power and utilities, to oil and gas and financial institutions. Our solutions create more efficient production and distribution, capital allocation, renewable energy development, investment and sourcing, and help reduce costs by automating crucial business operations. Of course, this wouldn’t be possible without our people, which is why we have built a team of individuals from a diverse range of backgrounds.

Are you ready to help power the global quality of life? Join Enverus, and be a part of creating a brighter, more sustainable tomorrow.

Spatial Business Systems (SBS), now a part of Enverus, is seeking an Associate Project Manager to keep project delivery running smoothly while learning from experienced Project Delivery Managers and taking on more ownership over time.

**About the Role**

As an Associate Project Manager, you will split your time roughly evenly between project administration (resource planning, scheduling, reporting, and documentation) and client-facing delivery (small projects, upgrades, and EVP support). You will support Senior Project Managers and Project Delivery Managers on medium-to-large software implementations (AutoCAD-based design and similar applications) for utility, telecommunications, and government clients, growing into full project ownership on the path to Project Delivery Manager.

**Essential Functions & Responsibilities**

**Project Administration**

* Build and maintain project schedules, work breakdowns, and task trackers (Jira, MS Project) under Project Delivery Manager direction.
* Track budgets, burn rates, and hours against plan, and escalate variances early.
* Prepare status reports and dashboards for assigned projects.
* Maintain project workspaces, templates, and logs (meeting notes, action items, risks and issues, change requests).
* Maintain the M&S backlog (Jira/DevOps, Salesforce/Axosoft), the defect list for active projects, and PPM tool and workbook maintenance across the PMO.
* Support time entry compliance and invoicing readiness by following up on timesheets.

**Coordination & Communication**

* Schedule and facilitate project meetings, distribute agendas, and capture and circulate minutes and next steps.
* Act as the day-to-day point of contact for internal teams on logistics, scheduling, and process questions.
* Prepare client materials for Project Delivery Manager review, join client meetings in a supporting role, and lead communications on your own projects.
* Track dependencies and deadlines, and follow up with owners to keep work on schedule.

**External Delivery**

* Manage small, well-defined projects, upgrades, and EVP support engagements as the client-facing contact, with guidance from a Project Delivery Manager.
* Lead DDS M&S / Delivery (Data Services) status calls and coordinate follow-ups with project teams and clients.

**Resource Planning support**

* Keep project allocations, forecasts, and staffing assignments in the resourcing system current as plans change.
* Monitor team capacity and flag over-allocation, under-utilization, and unfilled demand to Project Delivery Managers and AUD/DDS leadership.
* Prepare capacity and utilization views for AUD/DDS leadership and support weekly and monthly resourcing reviews with clean data and clear summaries.
* Reconcile forecasted (pipeline) hours against logged hours and follow up on discrepancies.

**Organizational Support**

* Help maintain Delivery Team templates and methodology materials, contribute to AUD/DDS KPI tracking, and assist with process improvements as assigned by Project Delivery Managers and Delivery Leads.
* Reporting structure: No direct reports. Reports to an AUD/DDS Project Delivery Manager, works closely with the AUD/DDS Director and Delivery Leads, and takes assignments from each project’s Project Delivery Manager.

**Desired Experience**

* 1–3 years of experience in project coordination, project administration, resource management, or a similar support role; recent graduates with relevant internships or coursework will be considered.
* Working proficiency with MS Office; Excel skills (formulas, pivot tables, data cleanup) strongly preferred.
* Exposure to Jira, MS Project, DevOps, Axosoft, Clarizen, or comparable scheduling and backlog tools is preferred; experience with resource management or time-tracking tools is a plus.
* Consulting or professional services experience and client-facing project experience are preferred; familiarity with utilities, energy, telecommunications, or government sectors is a plus.

**Requisite Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities**

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate, timely data.
* Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines across several projects.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the confidence to follow up with team members, PMs, and leaders.
* Analytical mindset: reads allocation, utilization, and time-entry data, spots trends or gaps, and explains them simply.
* Proactive and self-starting, raising issues early rather than waiting for them to grow.
* Thrives in a fast-paced, event-driven environment, learns the delivery methodology, and accepts feedback and mentoring

jobs.title: Senior Regulatory Affairs Consultant – Senior Regulatory Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, *With Heart*®.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Regulatory Affairs Consultant – Senior Regulatory Project Manager to join our team supporting a leading biopharmaceutical sponsor. This role is based in the United States and offered in a remote capacity. As a Senior Regulatory Affairs Consultant – Senior Regulatory Project Manager, you will partner with Global Regulatory Leads to shape and execute regulatory strategies that bring transformative vaccines to patients around the world. This position plays a key role in global regulatory strategy, regulatory plan execution, submission readiness, and cross-functional decision-making. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams and senior leadership, apply project management best practices, and contribute to regulatory programs from development through registration and post-marketing. Responsibilities include leading the development and execution of global regulatory plans, facilitating Global Regulatory Subteam (GRST) meetings, and preparing strategic dashboards for senior stakeholders, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence program outcomes.

You'll join a fast-paced, innovative, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through strategic regulatory planning, global submission readiness, and cross-functional alignment. As a key partner to the Global Regulatory Science team, you will help shape and execute regulatory strategies for the U.S. and ex-U.S. markets. This is a highly visible, cross-functional role where your work directly supports the sponsor's mission. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Regulatory Affairs Consultant – Senior Regulatory Project Manager can explore career paths and expand skills across regulatory science and global development.

Key Responsibilities

* Partner strategically with Global Regulatory Leads to shape and execute forward-looking, globally aligned regulatory plans across all stages of development and post-marketing.
* Translate regulatory strategy into integrated, actionable plans with clear milestones, critical paths, risks, and opportunities to support effective planning and decision-making.
* Lead the execution of regulatory plans, ensuring day-to-day operations align with broader strategic objectives across global programs.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and senior leadership to drive clarity, alignment, and accountability for regulatory deliverables, timelines, and interdependencies.

* Partner with Global Regulatory Leads and cross-functional stakeholders to maintain effective GRST governance, meeting cadence, stakeholder alignment, and communication flow across global and regional teams.
* Prepare and deliver strategic dashboards, reports, and scenario plans to senior stakeholders, translating regulatory progress and risks into actionable business insights.

Candidate Profile

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

* Strengths in regulatory strategy, complex timeline and milestone management, and anticipation of regulatory risk
* Experience working in a regulated, matrixed life sciences environment
* The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly, including translating complex regulatory information for senior leadership and global stakeholders
* A patient-focused mindset, a commitment to bringing vaccines to patients, and strong attention to detail in regulatory documentation
* Comfort working with project planning tools, regulatory information management systems, and electronic submission processes
* Strong judgment, agility, and strategic foresight when managing competing priorities
* A forward-thinking, innovation mindset and a commitment to continuous learning and improvement

Required Qualifications

You'll need:

* A minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or related life sciences industry, with at least 5 years in regulatory or regulatory program management

jobs.title: Sprint Pod Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Pathways 2 Solutions, Inc. (Pathways) is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business helping government and commercial clients turn complex challenges into practical solutions. Our capabilities span strategic communications, technology, training, program management, and organizational improvement. We bring together experienced professionals who combine creative thinking with disciplined execution to help clients achieve measurable results.  
  
We help clients develop programs, introduce new technologies, engage stakeholders, and equip people with the knowledge and resources to succeed. Our work with the Department of Veterans Affairs supports initiatives that improve the Veteran experience. We welcome professionals who bring sound judgment, fresh ideas, and a commitment to delivering useful, reliable work.

**Position Overview**
=====================

The Sprint Pod Project Coordinator provides day-to-day project coordination and operational support to a multidisciplinary team supporting VA’s Digital and Remote Health Center for Innovation. The Project Coordinator provides the organizational structure and dependable follow-through needed for effective sprint pod operations.  
Working under the direction of the Pod Lead, the Coordinator keeps schedules, task boards, meeting records, deliverable trackers, and project documentation accurate and current. The role helps innovation, implementation, technical, communications, and evaluation personnel stay coordinated as they support digital and remote health initiatives. The position translates approved plans and team decisions into maintained schedules, documented actions, organized records, and clear status information.  
  
This is a support position with no formal supervisory responsibility. The Coordinator helps the team maintain visibility into its work, identifies gaps and overdue actions, and brings issues to the Pod Lead for resolution.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
===============================

* Develops and maintains the standard tools and templates for pod use across all projects.
* Runs the pod's sprint mechanics — cadence, tracking, action capture, and follow-through — and maintains the record of acceptance criteria agreed at the start of each sprint.
* Compiles pod velocity data and support the Pod Lead in reporting against the ±15% tolerance.
* Supports development of Project Charters and Project Plans for assigned projects.
* Produces project-level change management, communications, and training support materials in coordination with the program-level Communications Specialist and Training Plan Specialist.
* Coordinates onboarding of innovators and pilot teams to the DRHCI process, using the pilot team guidebook.
* Maintains the project central repository content for assigned projects — documentation, FAQs, templates, and contact points.
* Coordinates meeting and workshop logistics for the pod, including with innovators, vendors, and site participants.
* Maintains project phase tracking inputs and supports the shared tracking system with DHO.
* Supports pod reporting to the DRHCI Program Manager and to VA, assembling status inputs from across the pod.

**Leadership and Collaboration Expectations**
=============================================

The Coordinator is expected to be proactive, tactful, organized, and dependable. Success requires asking clear questions, maintaining accurate records, following up respectfully, and communicating concerns early.  
The position supports the Pod Lead and team members by coordinating information and activities. Project priorities, task commitments, staffing decisions, scope changes, and final deliverable approvals remain with designated leadership and authorized personnel.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Three or more years in project coordination or project support on client-facing delivery teams.
* Demonstrated experience running the mechanics of a sprint or iterative delivery cadence tracking, status, action follow-through, and documentation.
* Experience developing and maintaining standard templates and tools that other people use consistently.
* Experience producing communications or training support materials for a project audience.
* Strong organizational skills and written communication; reliable follow-through without prompting.
* Ability to obtain a VA background investigation or public trust determination.
* Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders in a client-facing environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
* Ability to learn and maintain approved project tracking platforms.
* Ability to work independently within established priorities while recognizing when questions or decisions require escalation.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience supporting agile, sprint-based, Kanban, or comparable team workflows.
* Familiarity with backlogs, work-item estimates, sprint progress reporting, and review or retrospective activities.
* Experience supporting healthcare innovation, digital health, telehealth, remote monitoring, or technology implementation projects.
* Experience coordinating deliverable review and approval processes.
* Familiarity with project tracking tools such as Microsoft Planner, Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet, or comparable platforms.
* Experience supporting distributed teams, multiple implementation sites, or government stakeholders.
* Experience supporting VA, another federal healthcare organization, or Veteran-facing programs.
* Relevant project management or agile training.

**Credentials and VA Experience**
=================================

No professional certification or prior VA experience is required.  
Relevant training or certification in implementation science, project management, change management, human-centered design, Lean Six Sigma, or quality improvement is preferred.

Administrative support for the dean will include maintaining the dean's complex calendar and official correspondence; professional memberships; establishing and maintaining electronic and hard copy file systems; coordinating travel planning; drafting memos, reports, grant requests, and proposals as needed; maintaining documents, confidential files and faculty tenure records; and reconciling the dean's corporate account and monthly expense reimbursements. Draft and synchronize communications from the dean for internal and external audiences across multiple platforms. Work closely with University Advancement on tracking alumni engagement and co-coordinating events.
  
  
Coordinate faculty meetings, including but not limited to notifying faculty and guests; communicating with faculty committees; distributing and maintaining records of meeting materials; taking and transcribing meeting minutes; arranging for meeting space, A/V and catering. Coordinate monthly staff meetings including preparing the agenda.  
  
Maintain State Bar of California, AALS, WASC accreditation files, bar exam records, and internal committees' files and correspondence for the law school; maintain subscriptions and communications from the ABA and other legal education entities; distribute information to law faculty and administration as well as university administration as appropriate.

Prepare formal reports and assist in the production of a variety of print and electronic communications as required by the dean.  
  
Maintain records of approved faculty travel; reconcile approvals to posted fiscal activity.
  
  
Publish and keep current law school directories, group e-mail lists and executive calendars. Ensure national and regional law school related contact information is kept current. Maintain and supervise the use of the Dean's Conference Room and related facilities.
  
  
Recommend organizational and procedural changes affecting administrative activities.  
  
Provide back-up coverage for the dean's suite front desk as needed.

Bachelor's degree required. Five years of increasing responsibility in office management within a non-profit or educational setting is ideal. Prior experience as an executive assistant required. Experience in a university academic administrative environment is preferred..  
  
Outstanding written and oral communication skills in English and sophisticated interpersonal skills required  
  
Excellent administrative and organizational skills; ability to plan, manage, and execute projects and events of various sizes from inception to completion with keen attention to detail.  
  
Sound knowledge of principles, methods and practices of electronic and hard copy record keeping and report writing. Knowledge of modern office practices, procedures, and equipment. Competence in use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in office settings is desired.  
  
Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment in relation to all forms of communication and problem solving.  
  
High level knowledge of the full Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, is required. Familiarity with social networking sites such as LinkedIn is desirable. Knowledge of the Brightspace platform, Doodle, and Eventbrite are helpful.

The role manages projects from initiation through implementation, stabilization, transition, and closure, with particular focus on healthcare coding, billing, reporting, and Revenue Cycle Management services.
* The Project Management Lead serves as the central point of coordination and partners with clients, operational leaders, Technology, Revenue Cycle Management, Client Success, Finance, Compliance, vendors, and other stakeholders to define scope and requirements, manage timelines and dependencies, resolve risks and issues, and deliver sustainable outcomes.

Essential Functions and Tasks:

* Collect, validate, and coordinate client and operational data required for coding, billing, reporting, interfaces, system configuration, vendor setup, and implementation readiness.

**About Willow Health**
-----------------------

In the United States, one in five adults experience a mental health illness and over 12 million people have thoughts of suicide. Mental health crises can be some of the most difficult times in a person’s life, and over 17 million people seeking behavioral health care experience a delay in accessing care. Willow Health is on a mission to significantly improve this experience by expanding affordable access to high-quality, evidence-based intensive behavioral health care. In order to make this mission a reality, we deliver a virtual, urgent crisis care program that provides personalized, recovery-oriented care for people experiencing behavioral health crises.

Willow Health offers patients immediate access to evidence-based virtual crisis psychotherapy, medication management, certified peer coaching, care management, and around the clock crisis coverage, while working to connect patients to the most appropriate next level of care.

Willow Health has launched its virtual behavioral health program in North Carolina and is preparing to open an in-person location where patients can see a clinician virtually. **POSITION SUMMARY**

The Project Manager role is responsible for managing the end-to-end delivery of large-scale fiber optic construction projects across multiple markets. The position will oversee project timelines, budgets, permitting, vendor coordination, and customer communications to ensure successful fiber deployments that meet operational and financial targets. The ideal candidate brings experience in OSP fiber construction, organizational and communication skills, and the ability to manage complex projects with minimal oversight in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment. **This position is remote in CO**

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Identification of candidate OSP engineering/construction firms, managing bid/vendor selection process and contract negotiation

* Providing accurate network maps to state 811 agencies and Vero Networks NOC
* Managing network maintenance and relocation projects (including emergency maintenance)

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 2+ years of experience in project management, fiber network engineering, or telecom infrastructure deployment
* 2+ years experience in OSP fiber construction
* Ability to develop and manage detailed project schedules, budgets, and scopes of work
* Analytical and organizational skills, with attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Vendor management and communication skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field
* Thorough understanding of fiber network cost structure and ability to identify and achieve costs savings during project execution
* Understanding of fiber engineering and documentation standards and principles
* Proficiency using mapping tools (e.g., Google Earth or similar GIS platforms)
* Familiarity with environmental permitting processes and regulations
* Experience using or managing data in proprietary geospatial or project management platforms
* Working knowledge of fiber optic equipment, network architecture, and splicing documentation
* Experience supporting state 811 programs, NOC coordination, and network maintenance or relocation efforts

**JOB DETAILS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* This is an Exempt position.
* This is a Full-Time position.
* This is a Remote position.

* This position requires the ability to sit and work at a desk for extended periods of time, using a computer and other office equipment.
* This position requires the ability to perform fine motor tasks, such as typing or using a mouse, for extended period of time.

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS**

* Base pay is paid at an annual salary rate. The range for this position is $105,000 to $120,000 depending on experience.
* Target annual bonus for this role is 10%.
* Paid life insurance, short-term disability insurance, paid medical plans, PTO, holidays.
* Dental and vision options.
* 401(k) with match.

**ABOUT VERO**

Vero was founded in 2017 with a focus on bridging the digital divide by serving schools and libraries in unserved and underserved areas. We have also established a fiber to the premises business that directly serves residential and small business customers in underserved regions. In addition, we now serve a small subset of large business and wholesale customers - which we typically use as a springboard for our consumer focused services for underserved communities. Our management team brings decades of experience in building and operating fiber networks for various customer segments, including residential, business, and wholesale clients.

AI data reviewers help turn enterprise sales manager ai training evaluation outputs into auditable labels, rationales, and regression cases for AuraOne Human Data.

--------------------

* Evaluate enterprise sales manager ai training evaluation model outputs against a versioned rubric and assign severity tags for Enterprise Sales Manager - AI Training Specialist assignments.
* Compare paired responses and pick the stronger answer with a written rationale.
* Label hallucinations, instruction-following failures, and unsafe content with structured tags.
* Capture ambiguous prompts and route them back to the program team for rubric updates.
* Maintain reviewer-quality scores by calibrating against gold-standard examples each week.
* Document recurring failure modes so the modeling team can target them in the next training run.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Prior evaluation, annotation, or human-rater experience on enterprise sales manager ai training evaluation or adjacent content for Enterprise Sales Manager - AI Training Specialist work.
* Comfort applying multi-page rubrics consistently across long batches.
* Clear written reasoning that names the issue and the rubric clause being applied.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to flag when a prompt itself is the problem.

* Tag an unsafe response with the correct policy category and severity.
* Audit a 50-row batch for rubric consistency and report drift to the program lead.
* Propose a rubric clarification after spotting a recurring failure mode.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Background in linguistics, content moderation, or trust & safety review.
* Experience with inter-rater agreement metrics and calibration cycles.
* Domain expertise that lets you spot subject-matter errors automated checks miss.

We also look for opportunities to increase the velocity of patient care, ultimately providing solutions that improve and extend patients’ lives.

Your Business — Customer Care

You’ll serve as a trusted partner to clinicians and administrators by resolving issues with urgency and empathy, and by guiding users through device and software workflows.

* **Technical Troubleshooting** — Guide customers through phone and email troubleshooting of medical devices and software, including Windows applications, web‑based tools, drivers, permissions, wireless connectivity, server issues, and unit‑specific error codes.
* **Suggestive Solutions** — Identify opportunities to promote additional value‑add products, services, or training that solve customer problems.

* **Customer‑Obsessed:** You build rapport quickly, listen deeply, and communicate clearly under pressure.

* **Process‑Driven & Precise:** You keep your queue organized, document thoroughly, and follow through reliably.
* **Continuous Learner:** You’re eager to build clinical, regulatory (FDA/HIPAA), and product knowledge in a dynamic environment.
* **Team First:** You collaborate across Customer Care, Technical Support, Sales, Service, and Finance to resolve issues end‑to‑end and provide backup support for the Customer Care Sales Support position.

**The Basic Requirements:**

* Associate degree or equivalent experience.
* Typically 1–2 years of direct customer service experience.
* Experience with high-volume inbound/outbound calls and email support.

jobs.title: Innovation and Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Pathways 2 Solutions, Inc. (Pathways) is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business helping government and commercial clients turn complex challenges into practical solutions. Our capabilities span strategic communications, technology, training, program management, and organizational improvement. We bring together experienced professionals who combine creative thinking with disciplined execution to help clients achieve measurable results.  
  
We help clients develop programs, introduce new technologies, engage stakeholders, and equip people with the knowledge and resources to succeed. Our work with the Department of Veterans Affairs supports initiatives that improve the Veteran experience. We welcome professionals who bring sound judgment, fresh ideas, and a commitment to delivering useful, reliable work.

**Position Overview**
=====================

Working under the direction of the assigned Pod Lead or Implementation Lead, the Specialist provides hands-on research, analysis, coordination, and implementation support across concurrent DRHCI initiatives. The Innovation and Implementation Specialist carries the business case for each assigned project from its start to its transition. At the front end, market research that validates the problem and establishes the project charter; at the back end, develops the Lean Business Case and Value Scorecard, updated market research, analysis of alternatives, and budget estimates that a project needs to transition to the Digital Health Office for enterprise scaling.  
The role contributes throughout the innovation lifecycle from understanding the problem and assessing local readiness to supporting pilots, gathering feedback, refining implementation approaches, and preparing resources for continued use. The Specialist applies sound judgment to assess information, identify gaps, and recommend practical solutions appropriate to the intended users and implementation setting.  
For assigned business-process activities, the Specialist carries forward the evidence and assumptions supporting a project’s business case from initial problem validation through pilot results and consideration for enterprise scaling. The role coordinates market research, project charters, value scorecards, and resource estimates, drawing on the data and evaluation team for measurement methodology and validated outcome data.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
===============================

* Supports market research for assigned projects, partnering with innovators to complete the Market Research Guide validating the problem, quantifying scope and impact, and assessing the market landscape to determine best value for VA.
* Coordinates creation of Project Charters outlining scope, resources, roles, and responsibilities to authorize and structure each assigned project.
* Develops the Lean Business Case and Value Scorecard for assigned projects transitioning to DHO, including measured impact against baseline and validated cost savings and ROI supported by evidence.
* Summarizes lessons learned, changes to assumptions, and unintended consequences for assigned projects.
* Socializes the business case with DHO and relevant local and national parties, gathering feedback and adapting scope as necessary.
* Updates market research to account for new analyses of alternatives and projected demand within VA as a project matures.
* Reassesses resource and funding needs for scaling, including additional costs for communications, training, and evaluation support, and produces budget estimate reporting.
* Contributes to the shared tracking system with DHO monitoring projects in transition and those accepted into the scaling pipeline.
* Works with the Data & Evaluation Lead to ensure the metrics and baselines committed at charter are the ones the business case will need at the end. Supports coordination meetings with DHO and relevant program offices to review scaling pipeline candidates and align priorities.

**Leadership Expectations**
===========================

This position has no formal supervisory responsibility. The Specialist is expected to take ownership of assigned work, collaborate effectively, maintain accurate status information, and communicate barriers early.  
The role may coordinate working sessions and contributions from multiple stakeholders. Decisions involving clinical practice, technology configuration, security authorization, procurement, resource commitments, or changes in scope are elevated to the appropriate authorized personnel.  
For business-process assignments, the Specialist works with the assigned innovation pod lead and designated data and evaluation personnel to maintain consistency between project assumptions, measurement methods, validated results, and scaling recommendations. Approval of project charters, funding commitments, procurement approaches, and enterprise scaling remains with authorized personnel.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Five or more years in business analysis, program analysis, or management consulting involving business case development.
* Demonstrated experience conducting market research or analysis of alternatives to support a build, buy, or reuse decision.
* Experience developing a business case with cost and benefit analysis that a skeptical reviewer accepted.
* Experience producing project charters and structuring project scope, roles, and responsibilities.
* Ability to work with quantitative evaluation data without owning the analysis, and to represent it honestly including its limits.
* Strong written communication for executive audiences.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and collaboration tools, including Microsoft Teams and SharePoint, and the ability to learn required tracking and reporting platforms.
* Ability to obtain a VA background investigation or public trust determination.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience supporting digital health

jobs.title: Program Manager, Jewish Leadership Accelerator
jobs.description:
Description:

**PROGRAM OVERVIEW**

The Jewish Leadership Accelerator (JLA) is a highly selective nine-month fellowship that brings the most ambitious young Jewish leaders in their 20s into one room. It was founded by philanthropist Laura Lauder through The Jewish Leadership Fund and Jewish Federation Bay Area and will launch in San Francisco in January 2027 with an inaugural cohort of 20 fellows before expanding nationally.

Over nine months, fellows sit down to private dinners with founders, investors and public leaders currently shaping the city, and moderate those dinners themselves. They take part in a day-long weekend retreat, set their own mentorship goals with introductions through JLA's network, and close the fellowship with JLAction, where they share their leadership vision with mentors and community leaders. Fellows receive a $2,000 stipend on completion and join a lifelong alumni network.

**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Program Manager is the engine behind JLA's first few cohorts. Reporting to the Program Director, they will think strategically about how the program should run, then get into the details to make it happen: planning the retreat, curating and preparing speakers, producing each weeknight dinner, and working hands-on with fellows from application onward. This is a new role at a new program. The Program Manager will build systems in real time, and the processes they document will become the playbook for JLA's expansion. The ideal candidate is organized, high-energy, and self-directed; equally at ease with a 25-year-old fellow and a foundation board chair; and motivated by building something new rather than inheriting an established structure. The role is base in Bay Area working primarily remotely with occasional travel, local meetings and events.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**Strategic Planning and Program Management**

* **Planning:** Partner with the Program Director on the nine-month plan: the program calendar, cohort timeline and session themes. Run a debrief after each dinner and gather fellow feedback to improve the next one.
* **Project management:** Own timelines, task lists and deadlines across every workstream. Prepare updates for Laura Lauder, the JLA Board, and advisory committees.
* **Budget and vendors:** Manage the program budget day to day, including stipends, vendor contracts and event costs.
* **Data and KPIs:** Keep fellow, speaker and partner records current, and report on fellow engagement, attendance, retention and alumni activity.

**Retreat, Dinners and Speakers**

* **Retreat:** Plan and run the day-long weekend retreat early in the fellowship, including venue selection, curriculum, and day-of logistics.
* **Speaker curation:** Work with the Program Director and founder to identify, invite and confirm the speakers for each dinner, with two guests per evening from business, tech, government and communal life. Support speaker outreach, scheduling, and keep speaker bios and materials current.
* **Speaker and dinner prep:** Prepare a brief for every speaker on the format, the cohort and the topic, and build a run-of-show for each evening.
* **Dinner logistics:** Coordinate venue selection, catering, guest lists, and day-of coordination.

**Hands-On Work with Fellows**

* **Fellow preparation:** Coach the teams of two to three fellows who moderate each dinner, introducing guests, leading the opening Q&A and running table discussions, so they walk in ready.
* **Day-to-day support:** Be the first point of contact for every fellow and offer support when needed.
* **Community:** Support JLA-funded, fellow-curated social gatherings and administer microgrant requests.

**Selection, Alumni and Expansion**

* **Selection:** Run the day-to-day of admissions: applications, rolling review, nominations and references, Selection Committee interviews, and timely communication with every applicant.
* **Alumni engagement:** Run local alumni events and support the annual cross-city gathering so the network stays active as each cohort joins.
* **Expansion:** Document processes, templates and lessons learned from the first cohort as input to the playbook for New York City and future cities.

Requirements:

**QUALIFICATIONS, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES**

**Required**

* Hands-on experience in program or project management: comfortable planning, prioritizing and tracking many workstreams, timelines, and vendors at once, with strategic thinking about what the next cohort needs.
* Ability to move fast and work well under pressure, achieving event and program deadlines, and staying calm and organized when plans change.
* Self-sufficient, with strong judgment: Confident in making decisions and solving problems without much guidance and knowing when to bring something to the Program Director.
* Comfort being public facing: represent JLA at dinners, the retreat and JLAction, welcome speakers and guests, and speak with confidence in front of fellows, senior leaders and donors.
* Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication, with the range to engage fellows in their 20s and founders, investors, donors and senior leaders with equal ease.
* An entrepreneurial spirit: comfort building a pilot from launch toward a multi-city model.
* Passion for building Jewish life in America among young Jewish leaders.
* Highly polished, passionate, and professional.
* Availability to work evenings and weekends as needed
* Ability to travel on occasion.

**Preferred**

* Past and current involvement in the Jewish community.
* Working knowledge of the Jewish communal and philanthropic landscape and of young adult engagement (the campus-to-young-professional pipeline).
* Experience with a fellowship, cohort-based or selective-admissions program.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's degree
* 3+ years of experience in project management, ideally relating to community engagement, leadership development, or cohort-based programs.

Salary commensurate with experience. Excellent benefits

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we're helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

We started by building storage servers from scratch in a Palo Alto apartment to save 90% on hardware. Turns out hard constraints make for pretty good engineering. That discipline forged a platform that performs as well or better than competitors, scales to multi-exabyte workloads, and costs a fraction of what AWS or Google charge. AI infrastructure runs on data. Storage gets hard at scale. We've been breaking, rebuilding, and improving that storage layer for 20 years.

Today, the world's leading AI infrastructure providers, neoclouds, and data-intensive businesses run on Backblaze. Our platform includes:

* **B2 Overdrive** - high-throughput object storage engineered for AI infrastructure, GPU workloads, and massive-scale data pipelines
* **B2 Neo** - white-label enterprise cloud storage powering neocloud platforms for AI, HPC, and media

* One enablement calendar for all post-sales teams, so leaders know what is coming and when.

You review results quarterly with post-sales leadership and advise on decisions where enablement is a constraint, such as hiring pace and ramp expectations.

**Enterprise Customer Success Manager**

**Location:** Remote | **Department:** Customer Success | **Reports to:** Director of Customer Success

More than 2,750 institutions and organizations use Gravyty to power over 25.5 million interactions a year and build lifelong relationships with students, alumni, and donors. We’re looking for a commercially minded Enterprise Customer Success Manager to protect and grow some of our most important partnerships. You’ll be a trusted advisor to your customers and own the results: renewals, expansion, and long-term retention.

**Purpose**

Retain and grow a portfolio of enterprise customers by preventing churn, driving renewals, and expanding accounts. Build strong relationships and deliver real outcomes along the way.

**Mission & Goals**

* Act as a trusted strategic advisor to customer leaders and executive stakeholders

* Maximize customer satisfaction and product adoption

* Prevent churn and drive renewal and expansion across your enterprise portfolio

**Responsibilities**

* Own a portfolio of high-value enterprise accounts and be accountable for churn, retention, and expansion targets

* Lead renewal and expansion conversations, including cross-selling new solutions, especially our latest product launch

* Identify risks early and act on them, and spot expansion opportunities and customer champions

* Deliver QBRs, success plans, and strategic executive check-ins

* Work with Sales, Product, Support, and Marketing to solve customer issues and grow accounts

**Main Tasks**

* Track progress against your churn, retention, and expansion targets, and build action plans to close any gaps

* Monitor health scores and engagement metrics to catch risk and opportunity early

* Run renewal, expansion, and cross-sell opportunities from identification through close

* Guide customers through adoption milestones and business reviews

* Document success plans and account activity in our CRM and CS platforms

* Use AI tools to streamline account prep, reporting, and day-to-day workflows

**Required Qualifications**

* A proven commercial track record in preventing churn, securing renewals, and growing accounts, with results you can point to

* 5+ years of B2B SaaS Enterprise Customer Success experience

* Experience in EdTech, higher education, or nonprofit

* Experience managing enterprise-level accounts and engaging executive stakeholders

* Demonstrated success cross-selling or upselling into existing accounts

* Strong communication and negotiation skills

* Comfort using AI tools, such as Claude Enterprise, to optimize your work and workflows

* Experience with digital engagement platforms such as CRM, email marketing tools, and CS software like Gainsight

* Strategic thinking and planning, plus the ability to juggle multiple priorities without losing customer focus

* Experience working with dashboards and reporting

**How You Work**

You take ownership and follow through. You hold yourself accountable for results, and when things get tough you stay resilient and positive. You’re organized, you take initiative, and you have a bias toward action, efficiency, and continuous improvement. You build relationships easily, with an approachable style that puts customers and teammates at ease. You’re self-aware, you give and receive feedback openly, and you’re a true team player and help make the people around you better.

**About Gravyty**

At Gravyty, we’re redefining how higher education, K-12, and nonprofits engage students, alumni, and donors. Our AI-powered platform breaks down data and technology silos. It brings student support, enrollment, retention, and lifelong alumni and donor engagement together in one intelligent platform. Trusted by more than 2,750 institutions and organizations, Gravyty drives better outcomes, greater efficiency, and stronger connections.

Our global team of passionate professionals share a commitment to innovation, excellence, and making a real impact. If you want to be part of a dynamic, purpose-driven company, Gravyty is the place for you.

We offer competitive benefits, employer-matched retirement plans, flexible time off, and a supportive environment where your contributions make a difference.

We’re committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you need an accommodation at any stage of hiring, please let us know and we’ll work with you to meet your needs.

------------------

Snappy Kraken is looking for an experienced **Enterprise Customer Success Manager** to own some of our largest and most complex customer relationships.

* Build relationships with executive sponsors and day-to-day customer teams

--------------------------

We need someone with **serious Enterprise experience**.

* 7+ years of experience in Customer Success, Enterprise Account Management, Implementation or a similar SaaS role

* Experience leading multi-stakeholder implementations
* Strong project and program management skills
* Confidence working with executive-level customers
* Experience managing renewals, retention risk and expansion

* The ability to understand technical concepts without needing to be an engineer
* Excellent communication, organization and follow-through
* Strong judgment and the ability to operate independently
* Comfort working in a growing environment where every process may not already exist

* Marketing technology or SaaS platforms
* Salesforce or other CRM integrations
* SSO, user provisioning or Enterprise platform configuration

You become someone our largest customers trust and someone our internal teams trust to run the work.

You see risk early, communicate clearly and take ownership through the outcome.

You organize it.

Rethink is the leading global provider of online research-based resources to support individuals with developmental disabilities. Our behavioral health platform (http://RethinkBH.com) provides clinical tools, staff training and practice management for private ABA service providers. Due to autism insurance mandates sweeping the nation, our behavioral health division is experiencing unprecedented growth.

Rethink Behavioral Health (a subsidiary of Rethink First) is in the digital wellbeing training in the workplace. Rethink Behavioral Health provides cloud-based treatment tools, training, and clinical support for individuals with developmental disabilities and their caregivers.  
  
The Billing Customer Success Manager is responsible for customer retention and account growth with small and mid-sized behavioral health practices focused on the delivery of Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) treatment to individuals with autism. The selected candidate will provide high-touch service to customers to ensure that Rethink products/services are meeting their needs, and to identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities.

The ideal candidate will have experience as an ABA medical billing/Operations professional and be very comfortable learning new technologies to conduct online demonstrations with customers.

**Job Duties:**

* Meet and proactively drive to exceed quarterly and annual retention targets.
* Identify account growth opportunities within an existing set of Billing customers, working closely with practice owners to showcase how the Rethink solution can support clinical and business needs.
* Develop and maintain an exceptional knowledge of Rethink’s behavioral health solution and RCM services.
* Oversee account metrics to anticipate customer issues and concerns.
* Drive to close upsell/cross-sell opportunities by demonstrating understanding of current and long-term customer needs, proposing appropriate solutions to address identified customer needs, and consistently moving the customer toward commitment.
* Resolve customer issues in an efficient, timely, and practical manner.

new_jobs.title: Supply Chain Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Range Energy**
----------------------

Range Energy builds powered trailers that help electrify heavy-duty trucking without requiring fleets to replace their tractors. We solve real-world problems with real hardware.

Founded in 2021, Range is led by experienced EV operators from Tesla, Zoox, Honda, and other leading OEMs. We are backed by strong investors and focused on building hardware that fleets will actually use.

The work is hands-on. Sometimes messy. Often fast. Always meaningful.

**What we look for in every hire:** Mission first. Team second. Self third.

**Winning attitude & ownership.** We move fast and hold a high bar for execution. You own the outcome, not just your piece of it. When the path isn’t clear, you find a way. And when you’re stuck, you ask for help early.

**Curiosity & humility.** You ask good questions, learn fast, and stay low ego. You put the mission and the people around you ahead of your own credit, stay open to feedback, and are quick to admit when you’re wrong.

**Integrity & trust.** You tell the truth, especially when it’s bad news. You keep your commitments, own your mistakes, and do what’s right. And you treat others the way you’d want to be treated.

If you like building real things, solving hard problems, and working with low-drama, high-output teammates, you’ll fit here.

**Role Summary**
----------------

As a Supply Chain Project Manager, you will combine strategic sourcing ownership with hands-on program management for Range’s supply chain function. You will hold the bill of materials accountable to cost targets end-to-end, run the day-to-day coordination across a multi-supplier base, and act as the connective tissue between sourcing, engineering, and manufacturing so that supplier commitments translate into on-time, on-cost delivery. This role suits someone equally comfortable negotiating a contract and running the project plan that keeps a dozen suppliers moving in lockstep.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own cost performance across the entire bill of materials, identifying savings and value-engineering opportunities holistically rather than supplier-by-supplier.
* Serve as technical project manager for the supply chain team – organizing and coordinating multiple suppliers in parallel, tracking milestones, and resolving cross-supplier dependencies.
* Conduct market research and analysis to identify potential suppliers, evaluate their capabilities, and assess market trends, ensuring the selection of optimal suppliers.
* Negotiate favorable contractual terms and conditions with suppliers, including pricing, delivery schedules, quality requirements, and service levels.
* Collaborate closely with overseas supplier and engineering teams to maintain cost objectives and schedule alignment across the global supply base.
* Proactively engage with stakeholders (including engineering, operations, manufacturing, strategy, finance, and design) to derive and execute the medium-term (3–5 year) business and technology roadmap supporting hardware development programs.
* Continuously monitor and evaluate supplier performance against quality, delivery, and cost targets; implement corrective actions when necessary.
* Lead the day-to-day process of ensuring successful partnerships – milestone adherence, change order management, quality assurance, and cost control.
* Provide regular reports and analysis on sourcing metrics, program status, supplier performance, and cost savings to senior management.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* At least 5 years of experience in strategic sourcing, purchasing, and/or program management in a hardware product environment.
* Bachelor’s degree.
* Strategic sourcing, financial and business opportunity analysis, comfort with legal frameworks and contract negotiation skills (development, supply, licensing, and service agreements).
* Demonstrated experience running multi-workstream projects or programs – building and holding schedules, managing dependencies, and driving cross-functional accountability.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, including C-level, engineering, legal, finance, manufacturing, and logistics.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and work in a team environment.
* Demonstrated ability to identify business process issues and drive process improvement.
* Deep experience in complex project management.
* Uncanny ability to execute.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Haves**
-----------------------------

* Advanced (Master’s, Doctorate, etc.) degree in business, operations, supply chain, or a related field.
* Experience in the electric vehicle industry.
* Experience with automotive component supply chain.
* PMP or similar project/program management certification.
* Mandarin-speaking ability is a plus.

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

* This role requires regular onsite presence at Range HQ in Mountain View.
* Physical Requirements: Ability to work in a shop environment, including standing for extended periods and occasionally lifting up to 50 pounds. Comfortable with occasional bending, kneeling, and climbing as required for infrastructure maintenance. Ability to sustain extended periods of sitting and computer usage.
* Travel Requirements: Minimal, primarily for supplier visits or industry events.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

Range Energy’s compensation package includes a competitive salary, equity for all full-time roles, and a generous benefits package. The salary range for Mountain View, CA based applicants is between $170,000 - $200,000 annually. The total compensation will be determined based on multiple factors including domain knowledge, experience and location.
