new_jobs.description:
**About Corvus**

We’re Corvus Robotics, a Physical AI company transforming how the world’s warehouses operate. By combining autonomous robotics, computer vision, and AI, we’re replacing manual, labor-intensive processes with intelligent systems that make inventory management safer, smarter, and more efficient.

Our flagship Corvus One drones autonomously track warehouse inventory around the clock, while Corvus Trident, our AI-powered forklift intelligence system, captures inventory movement in real time. Together, our technologies provide a complete picture of warehouse operations, helping enterprises improve accuracy, efficiency, and decision-making.

Our technology is widely deployed and delivering value for leading enterprises. We’re now building a future where warehouse operations are fully autonomous. At Corvus, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, solve challenging real-world problems, and help bring the next generation of intelligent robots to scale.

**About the Role**

At Corvus Robotics, we're scaling autonomous robotics across enterprise warehouses. We're looking for a Deployment Program Manager to own the end-to-end customer deployment process, from sales handoff through successful implementation and operational readiness.

You'll serve as the central point of coordination across Sales, Engineering, Customer Success, and field deployment teams, ensuring projects move efficiently from signed agreements to fully operational Corvus One systems.

This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives on ownership, cross-functional execution, and building scalable processes in a fast-growing robotics company.

**This field-based role requires approximately 20–30% travel** across the U.S., with occasional visits to our Mountain View headquarters. You'll work closely with customers and cross-functional teams to coordinate deployments, ensure site readiness, and drive successful implementations.

**What You'll Do**

* **Own end-to-end deployment programs:** Lead customer implementations from sales handoff through installation, commissioning, and operational handover.
* **Drive deployment planning:** Establish project timelines, milestones, resource requirements, and clear ownership across internal teams and customers.
* **Bridge Sales and Operations:** Translate customer commitments, site requirements, and commercial expectations into actionable deployment plans.
* **Coordinate cross-functional execution:** Partner with Sales, Engineering, Customer Success, and field teams to keep deployments on track.
* **Manage customer readiness:** Coordinate site assessments, infrastructure requirements, installation schedules, and customer dependencies.
* **Identify and resolve risks:** Proactively manage blockers, escalations, scope changes, and competing priorities to protect deployment timelines.
* **Build scalable processes:** Develop deployment playbooks, standardized workflows, and reporting to support growing deployment volumes.
* **Drive successful handoffs:** Ensure clear acceptance criteria, customer training, and a smooth transition to ongoing operations and support.

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience in technical program management, deployment management, implementation, or customer-facing operations.
* Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects from planning through execution.
* Experience coordinating hardware installations, robotics, industrial automation, or other technical deployments.
* Strong project planning, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate technical and business requirements into clear execution plans.
* Excellent communication skills and confidence working with enterprise customers and technical teams.
* A hands-on, highly organized approach with the ability to drive accountability and execution in a fast-paced startup environment.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in robotics, warehouse automation, industrial IoT, or hardware-software integrated systems.
* Background managing enterprise customer implementations or multi-site rollouts.
* Familiarity with warehouse operations, logistics, networking, or site infrastructure.
* Experience developing deployment playbooks, operational KPIs, and scalable processes.
* Experience working closely with Sales during pre-deployment planning and post-sales handoffs.

**Why Join Corvus Robotics?**

**Build technology that works in the real world.** Be part of a team bringing autonomous robotics and AI into real-world environments, solving meaningful challenges and transforming warehouse operations.

**Own your impact.** Take ownership of meaningful work, contribute to important decisions, and see the direct impact of your contributions as we grow.

**Help scale the next generation of Physical AI.** Join at a pivotal stage of growth and help build the technology, teams, systems, and processes that will bring autonomous robotics to enterprise scale.

**Grow alongside the company.** Work with talented, driven people across disciplines, tackle new challenges, expand your skills, and help shape the future of Corvus Robotics.

Compensation Range: $110K - $140K

new_jobs.title: Patient Services and Consult Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
#### **POSITION SUMMARY**

The Patient Services and Consult Coordinator serves as the first point of contact for patients, families, referring offices, and visitors at the front desk, and as the primary point of contact for prospective patients from initial inquiry through the surgical consultation. At the front desk, this role manages check-in and check-out, patient registration, eligibility and benefits verification, scheduling, phones, and patient payments, keeping clinic sessions running on time. In the consult role, it reviews new patient inquiries, referrals, and intake submissions to confirm that required paperwork and documentation are complete; schedules consultations; and coordinates with providers, insurance verification, and financial counseling so that patients arrive at their consultation informed and prepared. Once a patient has completed the consultation and is confirmed to proceed with a surgical course, the coordinator completes a documented handoff to the Surgery Coordinator, who manages the patient through surgery scheduling, surgery, and postoperative follow-up. This is a nonclinical position; it does not include rooming patients, clinical assessment, triage, medical advice, medical decision-making, or tasks performed by medical assistants or licensed clinical staff.

#### **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Front Desk: General reception, front desk, and checking in patients responsibilities
* Consult Coordination: Serve as the primary point of contact for prospective and new patients from initial inquiry through completion of the surgical consultation.
* Consult Coordination: Respond to new patient inquiries, referrals, and intake submissions received by phone, email, patient portal, in person, or other approved channels within established response timelines.
* Consult Coordination: Explain the practice’s intake and consultation process, required documentation, general timelines, and what patients can expect before and after their consultation.
* Consult Coordination: Distribute, collect, and review intake packets, referral submissions, health history forms, financial policy acknowledgments, and the Notice of Privacy Practices acknowledgment for completeness, confirming receipt of required items such as demographic information, insurance information, identification, intake and consent forms, medical records, and letters of support or referral, as required by practice protocols and payer requirements.
* Consult Coordination: Identify missing, incomplete, expired, or inconsistent documentation and follow up with patients, referring providers, and outside offices to obtain it within established timelines.
* Consult Coordination: Route documentation requiring clinical review to the appropriate provider or clinical staff. The coordinator confirms that documents are present and complete but does not evaluate their clinical content or adequacy.
* Consult Coordination: Coordinate with insurance verification and financial counseling to confirm that eligibility, benefits, and any consultationrelated referral or authorization requirements are addressed before the consultation.
* Consult Coordination: Schedule, confirm, and reschedule inperson and telehealth consultations, and send appointment details, preconsultation instructions, and reminders.
* Consult Coordination: Serve as a liaison between assigned providers and prospective patients during the preconsultation stage for nonclinical questions, scheduling, and documentation needs.
* Consult Coordination: Conduct regular checkins with patients during the preconsultation period to keep them informed of outstanding requirements and next steps.
* Consult Coordination: Track each prospective patient’s status from inquiry through consultation, and maintain an accurate, current consult pipeline in the appropriate systems.
* Consult Coordination: Following the consultation, confirm the provider’s documented outcome and communicate nonclinical next steps to the patient.
* Consult Coordination: For patients confirmed to proceed with a surgical course, complete a timely, documented handoff to the Surgery Coordinator, including documentation status, any outstanding items, and relevant patient communication preferences.
* Consult Coordination: For patients who are not proceeding, or who must complete additional requirements before proceeding, communicate next steps as directed by the provider and document the patient’s status accordingly.
* Records: Scan, index, and file incoming records, faxes, and outside reports to the correct patient chart; route requests for release of medical records to the designated staff member in accordance with HIPAA, the California Confidentiality of Medical Information Act, and practice policy.
* Records: Accurately document patient communication, checkin and payment activity, documentation review, status updates, and completed milestones in the appropriate systems.
* Communicate outstanding requirements, scheduling changes, and next steps clearly and compassionately.
* Escalate complex patient concerns, documentation barriers, or operational issues to the appropriate department or leader.
* Protect the confidentiality of protected health information (PHI) at the front desk, on the phone, and in written and electronic communications, including when requesting and receiving records from outside providers; follow minimumnecessary standards and report suspected privacy incidents promptly.
* Provide respectful, compassionate, and genderaffirming support without providing clinical advice, medical education, or medical decisionmaking.
* Maintain regular and reliable attendance sufficient to meet the position’s operational, patientservice, and team obligations, with or without reasonable accommodation.
* Comply with applicable laws, regulations, accreditation requirements, privacy and security standards, financial controls, and organizational policies relevant to the position.
* Other duties as assigned.

The Ethics Office team promotes integrity and ethical decision-making across the organization. We champion the Code of Conduct, provide guidance on workplace concerns, and support an environment where employees can raise questions or concerns through established channels. Our work spans different cultures, regulatory environments, and business contexts, where sensitive situations call for careful and consistent judgment. We look beyond individual matters to identify recurring themes, strengthen policies and processes, and help the organization apply its ethical principles in practical ways while respecting confidentiality and fair process. You will work with employees, leaders, and cross-functional partners around the world on questions that shape workplace culture and organizational trust. This creates opportunities to develop sound judgment, improve ethical frameworks and programs, and turn insights from real situations into clearer guidance and stronger practices. We are looking for an individual with a Legal, Ethics, or Compliance background to support our employees in North and South America. The new hire will lead Ethics Office initiatives, including project management, assessing policy and procedure needs, developing and implementing policies and procedures, reviewing policy queries from employees, reviewing and remediating conflict of interest declarations, and collecting and analyzing ethics and compliance data. In addition, the role will independently manage fair, thorough, and empathetic investigations into alleged violations of the Code of Conduct, support consistent and proportionate application of disciplinary actions and remediation following substantiated findings, and translate investigation insights into actionable recommendations that strengthen our ethical framework and a respectful "Speak Up" culture. Employee Support and Stakeholder Collaboration - Address policy and procedure queries from employees, providing clear, concise, and empathetic explanations. - Develop relationships with key business teams to offer ethics and compliance assistance, serving as a trusted and accessible resource that reinforces confidence in our "Speak Up" channels and investigation process. Data Management, Analysis, and Organizational Capability - Manage, aggregate, and analyze ethics and compliance data points to derive actionable insights. - Look beyond individual cases to identify root causes and systemic weaknesses in processes, policies, or controls, and propose practical improvements. - Support the development and delivery of ethics-related training, guidance materials, and internal communications designed to prevent misconduct and strengthen ethical decision-making. **About Bobyard**

Construction is a multi-trillion-dollar industry facing a shortage of roughly 349,000 workers — and it still estimates by hand. Contractors spend weeks measuring and counting materials off drawings, and that caps how many jobs they can bid. Bobyard’s AI takes a contractor from a set of plans to a bid in minutes instead of weeks. Our customers run real construction jobs on Bobyard, not demos. We raised a $35M Series A led by 8VC, with Primary and Pear.

**Who we are**

Builders. We ship real product to real contractors. If it doesn’t survive contact with a live job, it doesn’t count — we don’t do demo-ware.

Owners. There’s no layer between you and the problem, and no permission slip required. When you see the solution, you own it, end to end.

Independent minds. Strong convictions, open minds. We hire for how you think, not where you learned it — show us the work, not the résumé.

Fast movers. We decide quickly and optimize for impact, not consensus. You’ll be judged by the people in the problem with you, on what you deliver.

**About the role**

Our CSM team is growing faster than one leader can coach. You'll lead a pod of Customer Success Managers, own their retention and expansion numbers, and build the playbook the next pods will run on. You'll still take the hardest accounts yourself.

**What you'll do**

* Lead, coach, and hire a pod of CSMs, and set the bar for what good looks like
* Own your pod's gross and net revenue retention, and know where every account stands each week
* Spot stalling accounts early, and run the save plan yourself when it matters
* Drive renewals, upsells, and win-backs with your team
* Take customers from Implementation without a gap, and turn their feedback into product fixes with Product
* Build the coverage model, health signals, and dashboards that show where to hire and what to automate
* Jump on the hardest customer calls, from estimators to owners

* Commercial instinct. You're comfortable owning renewal and expansion targets

**Nice to have**

* Construction, trades, or field-service software experience

We move fast, and priorities shift as we learn from customers. Playbooks, context, and requirements are often incomplete when work starts, and you'll be expected to shape them. If that pace excites you, you'll fit in well.

**What we offer**

Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver, and it grows as you do.

new_jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

Crusoe is growing fast across offices, data centers and manufacturing sites in several countries. How we set goals, review performance, develop our people and bring new talent in shapes how every employee experiences Crusoe, and how quickly they grow with us.

As Senior People Operations Solutions Manager for the talent lifecycle, you are the product manager for how Crusoe reviews, grows and hires its people. Your focus is the systems that enable talent performance cycle and ongoing talent development: goals, check-ins, mid-year and year-end reviews, calibration, learning and career growth. You also design the recruiting lifecycle in Ashby and Workday and its hand-off into onboarding. You start from the outcome the business needs, partner with Centers of Excellence, design with the employees and managers who use the process, and deliver a complete solution across people, process and technology.

Reporting to the Director, People Operations Solutions , you lead solution teams partnering with our Talent and Learning teams, Talent Acquisition, Lifecycle Operations, UX design, analytics and IT. You'll bring a bias toward automation and AI, and the judgment to add process where it creates value and keep it light where it doesn't.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* Talent performance cycle: partner with Talent and Performance Management to deliver the performance cycle end-to-end, owning the workflow, system configuration, cycle operations, and user experience, making each cycle simpler and more useful for employees and managers.
* Ongoing talent development: build the processes and tools that deliver learning, career paths, internal mobility and succession programs designed by the Talent and Learning teams, so growth at Crusoe is continuous, visible and easy to act on.
* Manager enablement: partner with Talent and Performance Management to give managers the tools, data and prompts to coach, recognize and develop their teams between formal cycles.
* Recruiting lifecycle: own the recruiting workflow across Ashby and Workday, from requisition to offer accepted, and its connection to onboarding, including the candidate portal.
* Discovery and outcomes: define success with program owners and the people who use the process. Map the current journey, measure it and find the constraints.
* Solution design: use design thinking to frame the problem and prototype with employees and managers. Then design future-state journeys across people, process and technology, including service blueprints, standard work, controls and where AI or automation should take on manual work.
* Roadmap and delivery: own the roadmap and backlog for talent lifecycle products, and deliver in short cycles with demos to business owners.
* Technology partnership: lead the work with IT using agile development practices, including a shared backlog, sprint planning, regular demos and joint testing. Translate requirements into configuration and integration decisions for Workday Talent, Performance and Learning, Workday Recruiting and Ashby, and the tools around them.
* Launch and adoption: prepare readiness, enablement and adoption with Change Management, and hand each product to Lifecycle Operations with clear standards.
* Measurement and improvement: enable tracking of measures such as cycle completion and quality, manager and employee satisfaction, internal mobility, time to hire and data quality, and keep improving after launch.
* Global scale: design for many countries, entities and sites, including manufacturing and data center teams.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

We don't expect anyone to bring everything below. If you meet the requirements and some of the rest, we'd like to hear from you.

### **Required**

* 8+ years in talent management, performance and development programs, HR technology or HR product management, with several end-to-end launches
* Deep knowledge of performance management and talent development processes
* Process design skill: journey and process mapping, standard work, SOPs and RACI
* Comfort with data: you define the measures and act on what they show
* The ability to lead without authority and build trust with managers, talent and learning partners, recruiters and IT
* Energy for the pace of a fast-scaling company and a path not fully paved

### **Equivalent experience we value equally**

* Talent technology: Workday Talent and Performance, or comparable depth in another talent management system
* Recruiting: an applicant tracking system such as Ashby or Workday Recruiting, or hands-on recruiting operations experience
* Product delivery: design thinking and agile methods from business case through adoption, or product management at a talent management, learning or HCM software company
* Process improvement: Lean, Six Sig

**The job**
-----------

Enable Honey Homes’ growth by building scalable systems to make each member’s perceived Honey Homes experience exceptional. The long-term metric output is increasing retention and member satisfaction.

This is a new position at Honey Homes, reporting to the CEO and sitting on the Senior Leadership team. Informed by analysis and the broader team’s input, the Business Operations Lead will identify leading indicator metrics that will increase retention and build structural, scalable systems to improve those metrics. Former founders, general managers, consultants, investment bankers, or bizops leaders would thrive in this role.

The scope of this role is intentionally broad to allow for unfettered exploration of impactful work and flexibility in adjusting scope and focus at any time to maximally benefit Honey Homes’ members.

Honey Homes’ mission is to replace the hassle of home upkeep with comfort and joy. This is a hard problem, but a valuable one to tackle. Our work is a complex and intensive journey spanning software, AI, human labor, and consumer preferences. Getting it right unlocks tremendous value for homeowners, and creates thousands of American jobs. We’re a small and mighty team who enjoy working together, backed by top-tier investors.

**Outcomes and Competencies**
-----------------------------

* **12-month Outcomes**

  + **Increase Retention:** Meaningfully lift monthly-cohort renewal rate from Year 1 to Year 2

    - **Every visit is excellent in the member’s eyes:** Every scheduled visit exceeds the members expectations by showing up on time, being prepared, completing tasks, clear communication when the unknown becomes known, and proactive follow up.
    - **Stay connected with members between visits:** Member chats that need a human answer are tackled quickly, and drive improvement of our AI assistant’s capabilities in partnership with Product
    - **Handyman supply is always available:** Recruiting pipeline delivers a hire-ready, vetted handyman in every market ahead of growth needs.
    - **Training sets up new handymen for success:** Rebuild handyman onboarding so each new hire cohort rapidly achieves our quality metrics.
    - **Launch holistic fixes to hit goals:** Solve problems with structural programs that address large swaths of challenges in one go.
    - **Hire teammates to support growth:** Identify what needs focus and support, dive in to understand it, build it, and get someone else (or AI) to own it going forward.
* **Competencies**

  + **You solve problems from first principles.** You’re excited to solve problems in innovative ways, and you resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking
  + **You prioritize all day long.** You understand what's the most important thing to be working on for the long-term benefit of our members, and make sure it gets done.
  + **You’re unafraid of ambiguity.** Rapid change and learning is exciting to you, and you thrive in ambiguous, startup environments
  + **You’re analytical.** You let data win arguments. You are a data-first problem solver with excellent Excel / data analysis skills.
  + **You document everything.** You build repeatable playbooks that are continually improved. You share clear, concise and frequent updates with your team.
  + **You’re relentless.** You do what it takes to win, no matter what
  + **You’re a proven leader.** You have hired great people in the past, and managed high-performing teams. You effectively collaborate with partners across the company at all levels.
  + **You are passionate about recruiting:** You understand that hiring is a key part of any role, and you foster a culture of always-on recruiting.
  + **You act like an owner.** You do what it takes to support our members throughout the year.
  + **Curious quick study.** When you hear - 1/2" Angle Stop - you ask what that is, and add it to your personal dictionary. Same for processes and ways to solve problems.
  + **You're technical enough.** You use AI to accelerate your work, and expand your impact. You can understand the evolving constraints on building product, and work directly with engineers on new product that directly affects your goals.

The Project Manager, Central Operations provides the day-to-day project coordination and discipline required to move assigned initiatives from planning through implementation. This role maintains project plans, tracks milestones and dependencies, coordinates stakeholders, identifies risks, and ensures leaders have accurate visibility into progress.
  
  
Position Purpose
  
The Project Manager supports disciplined execution across the Central Operations initiative portfolio by creating structure, maintaining accountability, and ensuring follow-up occurs. Two Project Managers will provide capacity to support multiple concurrent enterprise initiatives.
  
  
Essential Duties & Responsibilities
  
Project Planning & Coordination
  

* Build and maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, owners, and dependencies for assigned initiatives.
* Coordinate project meetings and follow up on action items and commitments.
* Ensure project documentation remains current and accessible.

Cross-Functional Coordination
  

* Coordinate work across Central Operations, field leadership, support-center functions, and external partners as applicable.
* Identify dependencies and support resolution of issues that may impact implementation timing.
* Help ensure responsibilities and ownership are clearly understood across workstreams.

Status Reporting & Risk Management
  

* Provide regular, accurate status updates for assigned initiatives.
* Identify risks, delays, and decisions requiring escalation.
* Maintain action, risk, issue, and decision tracking for assigned projects.

Implementation & Rollout Support
  

* Support the Director, Field Execution with practice-level scheduling and implementation coordination.
* Track readiness activities and assigned implementation actions.
* Support post-launch follow-up, completion tracking, and documentation of outstanding items.

Stage-Gate & Documentation Support
  

* Prepare materials and documentation needed for project reviews and implementation checkpoints.
* Track required decisions, approvals, and readiness criteria.
* Document lessons learned and improvement opportunities following implementation.

Implementation Resource Support
  

* Assist with coordination of contract implementation resources during designated heavy-lift activities.
* Provide clear schedules, task tracking, and documentation for assigned implementation support.

Travel Requirements
  
This role is primarily remote; however, periodic travel to field locations may be required to support implementation efforts, gain firsthand understanding of operational needs, strengthen field partnership, and ensure successful delivery of key initiatives.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 3–5+ years of project management, program management, operations, implementation, or related experience.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
* Strong organizational, follow-up, problem-solving, and written communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with stakeholders at multiple organizational levels.
* Proficiency with project-management tools, spreadsheets, and presentation software.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* PMP, CAPM, or similar project-management certification.
* Experience supporting multi-location implementations.
* Experience in healthcare, dental, retail, or another distributed operating environment.

Measures of Success
  

* Project plans and ownership remain current and clearly documented.
* Risks and delays are surfaced early for appropriate action.
* Stakeholders receive timely and accurate visibility into project progress.
* Implementation activities are coordinated with strong follow-through.
* Project documentation and lessons learned support continuous improvement.

Our innovative structural steel building systems enable structures to be designed, fabricated and erected faster and safer than any conventional alternative. * Strong Microsoft Office proficiency, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Teams.
* Experience supporting proposal development and document management.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent organizational and project management abilities.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in engineering, construction, industrial services, manufacturing, infrastructure, or technical services industries.
* Familiarity with proposal management and RFP/RFQ processes.
* Experience with marketing automation and email marketing platforms.
* Basic graphic design and content development experience.
* Knowledge of CRM reporting, dashboards, and sales analytics.

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Attention to Detail
* Organization & Time Management
* Collaboration & Teamwork
* Problem Solving
* Communication Skills
* Initiative & Accountability
* Process Improvement Mindset
* Data Management & Analysis

**Success Measures:**

* Improved CRM data accuracy and user adoption.
* Improved proposal turnaround time and submission quality.
* Consistent sales and pipeline reporting.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Remote
new_jobs.description:
Career Team is a leading workforce development organization on a mission to transform lives. We blend cutting-edge technology with compassionate, high-touch services to drive real, measurable outcomes in the lives of job seekers across the country. At Career Team, we're solving today's unemployment challenges with smart software, world-class trainers, dedicated case managers, dynamic job developers, and innovative partners. If you're passionate about making a difference and believe in the power of technology to transform lives, you'll feel right at home here.

**TITLE** Senior Project Manager

**REPORTS TO** VP of Project Management

**LOCATION** Remote

**EMPLOYMENT TYPE** Full-Time, Exempt Employee

***We're replacing the software and delivery practices that workforce systems have run on for decades, one state agency at a time. This role is responsible for leading those implementations.*** **Career Edge** is a fully integrated career readiness and case management software system supporting workforce and education entities. Our goal is sustained employment for career seekers, real results for employers, and stronger communities. We sell and implement enterprise software to state agencies and large workforce systems, and our reputation depends on whether those implementations succeed.

As a Senior Project Manager, you'll lead complex, enterprise-level client implementations from concept through go-live, working closely with a cross-functional delivery team. We focus on two things in particular.

**First, domain depth.** Our best PMs learn the client's domain well enough to hold their own with subject-matter experts, and they use that knowledge to make better project decisions. Workforce experience is a plus but not required. You do need a track record of learning an unfamiliar industry's rules and workflows and leading complex delivery in it.

**Second, comfort with an evolving PMO.** We are growing quickly and still building our PMO, and this role is focused on delivery while that work continues. You follow the process where it exists, find a practical way forward where it doesn't yet, and then adopt the standard once it is in place. If you've only ever delivered inside an established PMO, with governance handed to you, a template for every artifact, and a senior owner for every escalation, this role may not be a good fit.

**What You'll Own**

* **Delivery, end to end.** Lead enterprise-level client implementations from discovery through go-live, keeping them on scope, on time, and at a quality bar our clients expect.
* **The client relationship.** Be the strategic point of contact across the project lifecycle. Build executive-level trust, run discovery and alignment sessions that pin down scope, business outcomes, success metrics, and risk. Keep senior stakeholders aligned when their priorities collide.
* **Planning and trade-offs.** Turn business objectives into delivery roadmaps, milestones, and measurable outcomes the internal team can execute against. Guide the hard trade-offs on timelines, resourcing, and long-term scalability, and bring clear recommendations to clients and leadership.
* **Domain knowledge.** Learn each client's regulations, funding streams, and workflows well enough to make decisions, challenge a shaky assumption, and help steer the solution rather than just relaying questions between the client and the team.
* **Cross-functional execution.** Coordinate the work across Project Managers, Business Analysts, Solutions Architects, and Product Leads. You lead the high-level conversations on data migration readiness, timeline impacts, and cross-team dependencies without getting pulled into the technical execution yourself.
* **Risk management.** Identify delivery risks early, plan mitigations, and resolve routine issues directly, knowing when to bring others in.
* **Readiness and adoption.** Guide UAT planning through a business-readiness lens, and shape rollout plans, client training strategies, and long-term adoption after go-live.
* **Process discipline.** Follow established processes, fill gaps where none exist yet, and fold your solution into the standard as it takes shape.

**Why This Role**

* **We're growing.** We're scaling fast and winning bigger, and we need project leaders who want to grow with the organization.
* **Work that matters.** The systems you deliver help agencies connect people with jobs, and how each project goes shapes the client relationship for years.
* **A modern platform.** Cloud-native software built for workforce and the public sector.
* **A close-knit team**. We're small enough that you'll work directly with our executive team and see the visible effect your judgment has on the company. We work hard and enjoy working together.

**Who You Are**

* **A process-follower and a pragmatic improviser.** You hold teams accountable to the plan when there is one, and you build a workable path when there isn't one yet.
* **Willing to get into the details.** You handle detailed, hands-on work when the project needs it and solve problems without waiting for direction.
* **A fast, deep study of any domain.** You learn unfamiliar fields quickly and thoroughly enough to lead work in them.
* **A consultant at heart.** You dig in to uncover what the client needs and can guide them toward the right outcome, even when it differs from their original request.
* **Steady when things are unclear.** You stay composed in a room full of competing priorities, and when the path isn't fully defined, you help the team find one.
* **Comfortable with hard conversations.** When priorities conflict, you raise the issue early and work toward alignment, protecting the project without damaging the relationship.

At Vertech, not only do we develop world class industrial automation solutions for some of the top companies, we also strive to be the team of choice for the best and brightest talent. I mean, we call ourselves control freaks for a reason. The passion (and intelligence) our employees have is truly mind-blowing. In turn, we work hard to take care of our own with excellent benefits and pay, personal development, and transparent communication. We also know that you can be great at what you do and still have fun. If that sounds like a good fit, help us bring the next generation of automation solutions to nearly every industry, including manufacturing, food and beverage, renewable energy, water and wastewater, data centers, and more.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Implementation (Enterprise)
new_jobs.description:
The Program Manager, Implementation (Enterprise) supports the successful onboarding and technical enablement of large, complex healthcare organizations into Aledade's technology ecosystem. Working under the guidance of the Director, this role ensures that complex EHR workflows and integration strategies are implemented effectively and on schedule. The Program Manager is responsible for coordinating and executing implementation workstreams across a portfolio of concurrent enterprise accounts. The ideal candidate brings strong organizational skills, healthcare technology knowledge, and a collaborative approach to navigating complex, cross-functional environments in support of Aledade’s value-based care mission.

### **Primary Duties**

* **Implementation Execution:** Coordinate and manage enterprise onboarding project workstreams from initiation through go-live. Track milestones, maintain project plans, and proactively surface risks or blockers to the Director of Implementation. Support cross-functional coordination to ensure timely delivery of product and technical commitments.

* **Stakeholder & Relationship Support**: Serve as the primary technical and operational point of contact for enterprise client stakeholders during the implementation lifecycle. Facilitate collaboration and communication between client teams and internal Aledade teams, ensuring clarity on timelines, action items, and deliverables with client IT teams to ensure seamless data exchange and workflow optimization. Identify and surface enterprise-specific features to ensure Aledade’s technical solutions meet the needs of complex healthcare systems.

* **Process & Operations.** Support the development and maintenance of implementation best practices, templates, and standard workflows for top-tier EHR systems, specifically Epic Ambulatory, to support ACO initiatives. Contribute to process improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, scalability, and quality across enterprise implementation operations.

  + **Compliance & Quality:** Assist in ensuring adherence to applicable compliance requirements during onboarding, including Certified EHR technology standards and Promoting Interoperability guidelines. Help ensure accurate documentation and clinical quality measure reporting across assigned accounts.
  + **Performance Tracking.** Monitor project-level performance against key metrics. Prepare status updates, reporting outputs, and data summaries in support of organizational goals and leadership visibility. Suggest process improvements to enhance the efficiency and scalability of implementation operations.
  + **Post-Implementation Transition:** Manage the hand-off process from implementation to field teams, ensuring the client is fully equipped for long-term success and continued engagement.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical or relevant field. Significant relevant work experience may be accepted in lieu of educational requirements.
* 6+ years of relevant experience in healthcare technology (focused on implementation/project management).
* Proven experience with enterprise-level EHR implementations
* Experience configuring enterprise SaaS applications
* Knowledge of EHR integration strategies and healthcare industry standards, including FHIR and HL7.

### **Preferred KSA’s**

* **Enterprise Project Lifecycle:** Deep understanding of the end-to-end implementation process for high-value enterprise accounts, specifically within a SaaS or professional services environment, ideally population health or value-based care tools.
* **Organizational Dynamics:** Knowledge of how to navigate complex corporate structures, identifying key decision-makers, influencers, and blockers within large-scale healthcare or legal practices (or similar professional verticals).
* **Conflict Resolution Methodologies:** Understanding of various strategies to manage competing priorities and resolve friction between internal product/engineering teams and external client expectations.

* **Strategic Communication:** Ability to articulate complex project statuses, technical requirements, and value propositions to diverse audiences, ranging from C-suite executives to end-user administrative staff.
* **Negotiation & Influence:** Skilled at gaining buy-in for project timelines and process changes, ensuring that both the client and the internal delivery teams remain aligned on the scope of work.
* **Expectation Management:** Expert at setting realistic milestones and proactively communicating potential risks or delays to maintain trust and transparency throughout the implementation lifecycle.

* **Adaptability:** Ability to pivot communication styles and project strategies quickly based on the specific culture, needs, and feedback of different enterprise stakeholders.

Spatial Business Systems (SBS), now a part of Enverus, is seeking an Associate Project Manager to keep project delivery running smoothly while learning from experienced Project Delivery Managers and taking on more ownership over time.

**About the Role**

As an Associate Project Manager, you will split your time roughly evenly between project administration (resource planning, scheduling, reporting, and documentation) and client-facing delivery (small projects, upgrades, and EVP support). You will support Senior Project Managers and Project Delivery Managers on medium-to-large software implementations (AutoCAD-based design and similar applications) for utility, telecommunications, and government clients, growing into full project ownership on the path to Project Delivery Manager.

**Essential Functions & Responsibilities**

**Project Administration**

* Build and maintain project schedules, work breakdowns, and task trackers (Jira, MS Project) under Project Delivery Manager direction.
* Track budgets, burn rates, and hours against plan, and escalate variances early.
* Prepare status reports and dashboards for assigned projects.
* Maintain project workspaces, templates, and logs (meeting notes, action items, risks and issues, change requests).
* Maintain the M&S backlog (Jira/DevOps, Salesforce/Axosoft), the defect list for active projects, and PPM tool and workbook maintenance across the PMO.
* Support time entry compliance and invoicing readiness by following up on timesheets.

**Coordination & Communication**

* Schedule and facilitate project meetings, distribute agendas, and capture and circulate minutes and next steps.
* Act as the day-to-day point of contact for internal teams on logistics, scheduling, and process questions.
* Prepare client materials for Project Delivery Manager review, join client meetings in a supporting role, and lead communications on your own projects.
* Track dependencies and deadlines, and follow up with owners to keep work on schedule.

**External Delivery**

* Manage small, well-defined projects, upgrades, and EVP support engagements as the client-facing contact, with guidance from a Project Delivery Manager.
* Lead DDS M&S / Delivery (Data Services) status calls and coordinate follow-ups with project teams and clients.

**Resource Planning support**

* Keep project allocations, forecasts, and staffing assignments in the resourcing system current as plans change.
* Monitor team capacity and flag over-allocation, under-utilization, and unfilled demand to Project Delivery Managers and AUD/DDS leadership.
* Prepare capacity and utilization views for AUD/DDS leadership and support weekly and monthly resourcing reviews with clean data and clear summaries.
* Reconcile forecasted (pipeline) hours against logged hours and follow up on discrepancies.

**Organizational Support**

* Help maintain Delivery Team templates and methodology materials, contribute to AUD/DDS KPI tracking, and assist with process improvements as assigned by Project Delivery Managers and Delivery Leads.
* Reporting structure: No direct reports. Reports to an AUD/DDS Project Delivery Manager, works closely with the AUD/DDS Director and Delivery Leads, and takes assignments from each project’s Project Delivery Manager.

**Desired Experience**

* 1–3 years of experience in project coordination, project administration, resource management, or a similar support role; recent graduates with relevant internships or coursework will be considered.
* Working proficiency with MS Office; Excel skills (formulas, pivot tables, data cleanup) strongly preferred.
* Exposure to Jira, MS Project, DevOps, Axosoft, Clarizen, or comparable scheduling and backlog tools is preferred; experience with resource management or time-tracking tools is a plus.
* Consulting or professional services experience and client-facing project experience are preferred; familiarity with utilities, energy, telecommunications, or government sectors is a plus.

**Requisite Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities**

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate, timely data.
* Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines across several projects.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the confidence to follow up with team members, PMs, and leaders.
* Analytical mindset: reads allocation, utilization, and time-entry data, spots trends or gaps, and explains them simply.
* Proactive and self-starting, raising issues early rather than waiting for them to grow.
* Thrives in a fast-paced, event-driven environment, learns the delivery methodology, and accepts feedback and mentoring

The Project Coordinator provides the organizational structure and dependable follow-through needed for effective sprint pod operations.  
Working under the direction of the Pod Lead, the Coordinator keeps schedules, task boards, meeting records, deliverable trackers, and project documentation accurate and current. The role helps innovation, implementation, technical, communications, and evaluation personnel stay coordinated as they support digital and remote health initiatives. The position translates approved plans and team decisions into maintained schedules, documented actions, organized records, and clear status information.  
  
This is a support position with no formal supervisory responsibility. The Coordinator helps the team maintain visibility into its work, identifies gaps and overdue actions, and brings issues to the Pod Lead for resolution.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
===============================

* Develops and maintains the standard tools and templates for pod use across all projects.

* Maintains project phase tracking inputs and supports the shared tracking system with DHO.
* Supports pod reporting to the DRHCI Program Manager and to VA, assembling status inputs from across the pod.

**Leadership and Collaboration Expectations**
=============================================

The Coordinator is expected to be proactive, tactful, organized, and dependable. Success requires asking clear questions, maintaining accurate records, following up respectfully, and communicating concerns early.

Company Overview:

**Verathon** is a global medical device company committed to being a trusted partner to our customers and advancing patient care through innovative Airway Management and Urology solutions. For more than 40 years, we have worked alongside healthcare professionals to understand their needs and deliver high-quality technologies that provide lasting clinical and economic value.

Our portfolio includes leading GlideScope**®** video laryngoscopy and BFlex™ bronchoscopy solutions, BladderScan**®** bladder volume measurement, and a growing range of single-use Urology solutions. Behind our innovations is a diverse, global team united by a commitment to our customers, collaboration, and improving patient care.

Verathon, a business unit of Roper Technologies, is headquartered in Bothell, Washington, with international subsidiaries in Canada, Europe, and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit www.verathon.com.

Overview:

Be Part of Our Story

Bring your talents to a rapidly growing, industry-leading global medical device company.

We operate with a singular focus of empowering healthcare professionals to better serve their patients. Our unique products and services help clinicians see the hidden realities of the human body, giving them insights they need to optimize patient care.

For us, it starts with people: our team, our customers, and the patients they serve. Our innovation is based on finding new ways to offer simplicity where complexity exists. We also look for opportunities to increase the velocity of patient care, ultimately providing solutions that improve and extend patients’ lives.

Your Business — Customer Care

As a **Customer Care Specialist**, you’ll deliver total customer care across orders, product and training inquiries, and moderate‑level technical support. new_jobs.description:
Description:

**PROGRAM OVERVIEW**

The Jewish Leadership Accelerator (JLA) is a highly selective nine-month fellowship that brings the most ambitious young Jewish leaders in their 20s into one room. It was founded by philanthropist Laura Lauder through The Jewish Leadership Fund and Jewish Federation Bay Area and will launch in San Francisco in January 2027 with an inaugural cohort of 20 fellows before expanding nationally.

Over nine months, fellows sit down to private dinners with founders, investors and public leaders currently shaping the city, and moderate those dinners themselves. They take part in a day-long weekend retreat, set their own mentorship goals with introductions through JLA's network, and close the fellowship with JLAction, where they share their leadership vision with mentors and community leaders. Fellows receive a $2,000 stipend on completion and join a lifelong alumni network.

**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Program Manager is the engine behind JLA's first few cohorts. Reporting to the Program Director, they will think strategically about how the program should run, then get into the details to make it happen: planning the retreat, curating and preparing speakers, producing each weeknight dinner, and working hands-on with fellows from application onward. This is a new role at a new program. The Program Manager will build systems in real time, and the processes they document will become the playbook for JLA's expansion. The ideal candidate is organized, high-energy, and self-directed; equally at ease with a 25-year-old fellow and a foundation board chair; and motivated by building something new rather than inheriting an established structure. The role is base in Bay Area working primarily remotely with occasional travel, local meetings and events.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**Strategic Planning and Program Management**

* **Planning:** Partner with the Program Director on the nine-month plan: the program calendar, cohort timeline and session themes. Run a debrief after each dinner and gather fellow feedback to improve the next one.
* **Project management:** Own timelines, task lists and deadlines across every workstream. Prepare updates for Laura Lauder, the JLA Board, and advisory committees.
* **Budget and vendors:** Manage the program budget day to day, including stipends, vendor contracts and event costs.
* **Data and KPIs:** Keep fellow, speaker and partner records current, and report on fellow engagement, attendance, retention and alumni activity.

**Retreat, Dinners and Speakers**

* **Retreat:** Plan and run the day-long weekend retreat early in the fellowship, including venue selection, curriculum, and day-of logistics.
* **Speaker curation:** Work with the Program Director and founder to identify, invite and confirm the speakers for each dinner, with two guests per evening from business, tech, government and communal life. Support speaker outreach, scheduling, and keep speaker bios and materials current.
* **Speaker and dinner prep:** Prepare a brief for every speaker on the format, the cohort and the topic, and build a run-of-show for each evening.
* **Dinner logistics:** Coordinate venue selection, catering, guest lists, and day-of coordination.

**Hands-On Work with Fellows**

* **Fellow preparation:** Coach the teams of two to three fellows who moderate each dinner, introducing guests, leading the opening Q&A and running table discussions, so they walk in ready.
* **Day-to-day support:** Be the first point of contact for every fellow and offer support when needed.
* **Community:** Support JLA-funded, fellow-curated social gatherings and administer microgrant requests.

**Selection, Alumni and Expansion**

* **Selection:** Run the day-to-day of admissions: applications, rolling review, nominations and references, Selection Committee interviews, and timely communication with every applicant.
* **Alumni engagement:** Run local alumni events and support the annual cross-city gathering so the network stays active as each cohort joins.
* **Expansion:** Document processes, templates and lessons learned from the first cohort as input to the playbook for New York City and future cities.

Requirements:

**QUALIFICATIONS, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES**

**Required**

* Hands-on experience in program or project management: comfortable planning, prioritizing and tracking many workstreams, timelines, and vendors at once, with strategic thinking about what the next cohort needs.
* Ability to move fast and work well under pressure, achieving event and program deadlines, and staying calm and organized when plans change.
* Self-sufficient, with strong judgment: Confident in making decisions and solving problems without much guidance and knowing when to bring something to the Program Director.
* Comfort being public facing: represent JLA at dinners, the retreat and JLAction, welcome speakers and guests, and speak with confidence in front of fellows, senior leaders and donors.
* Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication, with the range to engage fellows in their 20s and founders, investors, donors and senior leaders with equal ease.
* An entrepreneurial spirit: comfort building a pilot from launch toward a multi-city model.
* Passion for building Jewish life in America among young Jewish leaders.
* Highly polished, passionate, and professional.
* Availability to work evenings and weekends as needed
* Ability to travel on occasion.

**Preferred**

* Past and current involvement in the Jewish community.
* Working knowledge of the Jewish communal and philanthropic landscape and of young adult engagement (the campus-to-young-professional pipeline).
* Experience with a fellowship, cohort-based or selective-admissions program.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's degree
* 3+ years of experience in project management, ideally relating to community engagement, leadership development, or cohort-based programs.

Salary commensurate with experience. Excellent benefits

Bisk is seeking a Senior Marketing Account Manager to serve as the primary strategic and operational marketing lead for a portfolio of university partners. The Senior Marketing Account Manager is the strategic and executional hub connecting Bisk's marketing capabilities to the goals of our university partners. This is not a support role — it is a leadership position responsible for co-creating annual marketing strategy, continuous analysis, portfolio optimization, partner satisfaction, and cross-functional project delivery across a portfolio of graduate degree programs

You will own the relationship, the results, and the roadmap — from annual planning to weekly campaign optimization to quarterly partner business reviews.

The ideal candidate operates at the intersection of client leadership, growth strategy, and execution excellence, ensuring marketing investments drive measurable enrollment outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary day-to-day and executive point of contact for our university marketing stakeholders.

new_jobs.title: Marketing Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**Marketing Operations Analyst | Remote, United States**
========================================================

  

Pax8 is hiring a remote Marketing Operations Analyst in the United States to strengthen the systems, data, and automation connecting our global marketing and revenue teams.

**Build the engine behind smarter global marketing**
----------------------------------------------------

Join a highly collaborative team where you’ll become a trusted Marketo expert and help shape how Pax8 manages data, develops leads, and scales marketing operations worldwide. You’ll have the autonomy to improve a sophisticated marketing technology environment while growing alongside new artificial intelligence capabilities that are changing how modern teams work.

**Be part of the Pax8 journey**
-------------------------------

Pax8 connects technology partners, vendors, and small to midsized businesses through an intelligent cloud marketplace. Our culture values curiosity, thoughtful collaboration, continuous learning, and people who turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes. Explore the Pax8 story and see the latest developments in our United States newsroom .

**️ What you’ll be doing**
--------------------------

* **Own the operational health of Marketo** , ensuring its architecture, automation, processes, and integrations remain reliable, scalable, and effective.
* **Connect Marketo and Salesforce successfully** , partnering with Salesforce administrators to improve synchronization, shared data, and lead flows.
* **Strengthen data operations** by advancing enrichment, standardization, governance, quality, and compliance across the marketing technology environment.
* **Shape the global lead journey** , refining lead scoring, lifecycle stages, routing, and marketing-qualified lead delivery so opportunities reach the right teams at the right time.
* **Monitor performance continuously** , identifying where systems, logic, and business processes can be fine-tuned before issues affect users or outcomes.
* **Translate business needs into technical solutions** , using discovery conversations and data insights to design practical operational workflows and architecture.
* **Guide integrated technology** , working with the owners of platforms such as Cvent, ZoomInfo, digital asset management tools, Workfront, and Jira to support dependable connections and performance.
* **Support teams around the world** , providing practical guidance and governance to Marketing, Revenue Enablement, and regional campaign teams.
* **Create reusable global systems** , partnering with Campaign Operations to develop approaches that improve consistency without limiting regional needs.
* **Bring ideas into the conversation** , recommending innovations that help Pax8 build a best-in-class marketing operations capability.

**The impact you’ll make**
--------------------------

You’ll help ensure that Marketo is aligned, dependable, and ready to support Pax8 at scale. Your work will give marketing and revenue teams greater confidence in their data, create a clearer journey from engagement to qualified lead, and uncover opportunities to make our systems and processes better. As a trusted subject-matter expert, you’ll influence decisions that reach teams and partners across the globe.

**You’ll be ideal for us if you**
---------------------------------

* Bring **extensive hands-on Marketo administration experience** , ideally supported by Marketo certification.
* Understand advanced Marketo operational practices, including Velocity scripting, executable campaigns, traffic-control processes, data operations, lead scoring, and lifecycle management.
* Have proven experience managing integrations between Marketo and Salesforce, including dependencies, synchronization, data structure, and troubleshooting.
* Are comfortable working across complex marketing technology environments with several connected platforms.
* Can discover, collect, interpret, and simplify business requirements, then translate them into clear technical workflows and operational architecture.
* Know how to protect data accuracy, integrity, governance, and compliance across interconnected systems.
* Collaborate effectively with administrators, product managers, technical specialists, campaign teams, and business stakeholders.
* Bring a methodical approach to supervising, assessing, and analyzing system performance.
* Can manage several priorities while maintaining clear documentation, thoughtful communication, and dependable follow-through.
* Use data to develop recommendations, challenge assumptions, and improve business outcomes.
* Can explain how you have made Marketo work better in previous environments, including the problem you uncovered, the changes you recommended, and the results delivered.
* Enjoy contributing to a calm, collaborative, outcomes-focused team where people challenge ideas constructively and deliver on their commitments.

**Trust and hiring**
--------------------

At Pax8, we care deeply about building genuine, trust based relationships — starting with how we hire.

To protect our business, our teams, and our customers, we use a range of measures throughout the recruitment process to help confirm authenticity and prevent fraud. These safeguards are designed to be fair, respectful, and proportionate, and may evolve as risks change. By applying, you acknowledge that we take steps to verify identity and representation during hiring. new_jobs.title: Luxury Market Manager
new_jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

We're looking for a Luxury Market Manager to grow a portfolio of high-end vacation homes across Florida. You'll be the local market expert. You'll find and sign new luxury homeowners and hosts, launch new markets, and manage a portfolio of host relationships. You'll split your time between strategic growth and hands-on problem solving, working closely with internal guest services, quality, product and policy teams.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead acquisition of new hosts and listings in assigned markets, moving qualified leads through the pipeline to meet and exceed quarterly supply goals
* Find high-quality homes through research, networking and partnerships with luxury real estate professionals, property managers and operators
* Qualify incoming leads and hand fully vetted hosts and listings to the onboarding team with clear documentation
* Present a compelling value proposition to luxury homeowners by phone, email and in person
* Own new market launches from start to finish: lead generation, host recruitment, coordination with quality and guest services teams, and tracking performance after launch
* Build deep market knowledge, including neighborhoods, architectural styles, design aesthetics, pricing trends, seasonality and competitors
* Create and maintain local pitches for luxury homeowners and real estate professionals
* Manage a portfolio of luxury hosts as their main point of contact and trusted advisor
* Run regular business reviews and optimization calls, and give data-driven recommendations
* Support onboarding of new listings, and improve bookability through performance analysis and host education
* Design strategies to manage and optimize long-tail hosts across your markets
* Act as the liaison between hosts and internal teams on escalations and strategic initiatives, routing requests to the right resources
* Share host feedback with stakeholders to inform product and policy decisions
* Educate hosts on product updates, policy changes and best practices

### **Qualifications**

**Required**

* 6+ years in sales, account management, business development or strategic partnerships
* Proven record of meeting or exceeding acquisition and/or revenue targets in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment
* Experience working across teams to influence change and drive results
* Familiarity with CRM tools, with disciplined pipeline management and reporting
* Strong executive presence and the ability to influence senior decision-makers
* Excellent negotiation skills, including closing complex, high-value partnerships
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders
* Comfortable with ambiguity and quick to adapt
* Consultative, relationship-first, proactive and collaborative
* English proficiency
* Based in or near Florida, and able to travel up to 50%

**Preferred**

* Experience in luxury travel, hospitality or real estate
* Spanish proficiency
* Passion for luxury travel and homes

### **Key Details**

* **Start date:** December 1, 2026
* **Duration:** Through May 1, 2027 (about 5 months)
* **Location:** Remote, based in Florida. Travel up to 50% across Florida, the U.S. Southeast and the Caribbean, plus team off-sites
* **Work schedule:** Full-time, 40 hours/week (5 days)
* **Pay rate range:** $65-$75/hour + benefits
* **Work Authorization:** Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.
* **Engagement:** W-2 Contract
